Here everyone is a sage to himself Without limit. Let him shut up, and that's the end of it.

805-2

Let's sum up God. To the one people loved, Let's add Jehovah, that is, the Living One, And the one who created the Universe. The God who led Abraham, With the God of Christians' Isa, With Buddha, the God of nirvana And Allah of Muslim brothers, With the gods of thunderstorm and swamp, Of seas, stars and luminaries — And we'll get Sabaoth, The Essence of Space and Powers.

804-0 (an argument even with my wife)

A hundred talents to God — Ten from kings, Who at the expense of the debt Of simple workers. We all carry to the Creator, Give or steal: Bourgeois and communist. Tzaddik and baptist, Sectarian and atheist. "I live for myself," — I say, I'll give away the gathered, To the last kopeck I'll dare To idols-little gods — However you turn it, to the Lord of princes.

803-7

It's not betrayal, it's nature That calls to take, gives a chance — Fate's sincere reward, Not a salary, then an advance. Why refuse, Like one of the loser-wretches? I live once, and I'm not eternal — I drink happiness while I have strength. There'll be something to remember in old age, "Cool grandma," — the grandson will say, Or they'll curse For the tragedies of partings.

802-8

Foucault is not God, but humanity's eyes. The researcher didn't establish the law. But tourists keep showing off, Babylon builds the tower. Flights to space, quanta — towers: "There is no Creator, for we are creators." Doesn't a set of clothes Belong to its owner? He just breathed and we are alive. Alive, like Him, Specks from His lungs, Look, even the sun rises to bow — To Him! It gifts a new day!

801-9

They expect lightness from me Without escalating problems — The question of urgent primacy We'll postpone for now, Or let them burn as with fire. We skip the lesson and don't go to school. One can take a break, Even laugh at trouble — It's not so alarming When to rest a bit today, And tomorrow roll up sleeves And grab it firmly. Woe is to forget about the напасть, To stop even praying, Better to drink to the brim Of bitter acid-poison Than to turn out a traitor.

800-9

A ruler is nobody without a team. Without a party, pack, gang He himself is a worthless weakling, Even if a Cossack, But no name. He'll surround himself with guards, Proclaim himself tsar, Pay him tax, Submit to him and live. For safety he'll build a fortress, In the middle a grandiose palace Next to a temple, monastery or mosque. As God's viceroy for the masses He'll put serfs and peasants on the meter To tend gardens and vegetable plots, And at a convenient opportunity, Send them first to death To enslave other peoples too.

799-9

Leave me and let go, In my thoughts now it's not you, Why waste life? You'll let go, and I'll love again. Darling, I found love, To her I strive again and again. To warm lips. Yours are like ice. Beloved, we should part. LEAVE me and realize: Love harms us both, For us to live together is family pain, You'll let go, I'll love her. (Don't hold. Let go!)

798-9

Like other prophets, Christ did not create, He explained The deep Design Of Life itself, By the power of Words The disturbed peace Of the holes of Non-being, A flash of Love, Of Light and Warmth, In which burn Death and untruth. But scientific thoughts At first for evil, As protest, arise, To glorify the Author tomorrow. Crucified he died, Revealing the Mystery by resurrection, Who believed knows now To what the Almighty calls.

797-9

If only to scoop from the night, If only to cool the day — Anomalous heat rages… Nature doesn't want Harmful inspirations By which man destroys. It hints and asks: "Children of the planet! Come to your senses! Calm down! Enough! Dismantle the rockets! Make peace! To be at enmity And to compete, To rob And to seek excessive good Stop! Stop Crossing boundaries! Start fraternizing, Don't kill, Live, Climb down From the Babylonian tower."

796-8

Grandma, where is your slenderness? The bloom fell off, spring won't return, Beauty was replaced by patience and wisdom To bear fruit in old age. Not everyone will appreciate Your efforts To serve good, to improve the world, Not everyone will believe In ardent love Under the gray of wrinkled years. "Pick and eat, I'm glad to give myself away, For that's why the cherry grows in the garden," — The grandma explained and calmed, — "And the tree will bloom again in spring."

795-8

The body depends on age, The soul is always young. Stuffed into a smoldering cage, It craves freedom. It perceives will through bars. With the help of hands and feet It tries to play at life. And who would help it? He who limited it, Controls the inexperienced movement, Teaches for eternity and secured the passage, — God's eternal Spirit.

794-9

«They didn't love us, They attacked us,» — In a fume of hangover Unsuccessful explanations. Didn't you attack first To provoke rage? Not everyone will accept Your propaganda tale. Truth hasn't died in the world, And you won't kill it, Monster of the adversary, And in hell you'll burn.

793-8

We joked, We bypassed Serious разборки, We quarreled, We avoided offenses, Hours flew, Deflated like dust, Pressing relations in dreams. But before dreams or at dawn Thoughts gathered into focus, And a dear person, not some mistress, The palm of the hand wanted to feel. To tell the heart And convey to her: "Whether tomorrow comes or yesterday passes, I don't care!" "I love you."

792-9

Taras bequeathed and I have the right To care for the body while alive. It became a bearer of God's plan, Molded from dust it received the soul, Into a peculiar earthly vessel for it. The crematorium's fire will simplify rituals, Without ceremony gather into ash What was once called Mykhailo, So with his beloved in the urn he's buried When parting with loved ones comes. In the embrace of the one given by the Lord As a generator of good and meaningful inspirations, Planet-Mama will receive us forever In a single place and on the same day, And the Father will meet in starry temples To choirs of heavenly songs.

791-9

More than I can give, Don't hesitate, take, I allow, I don't know How else to prove That I truly love you. It's a sin when prohibitions, A violation of the fidelity oath, — I'm opening Temporarily the borders, You can take the most secret. Fill yourself with happiness to the brim, Tear away boundlessly, Don't be afraid. Come back again And share — I'm waiting.

790-9

Internal organs absorb the external, So it captures from within too, Today's becomes yesterday's Under the sight of the next day. The funnel sucks sand and water, Pours out at the exit and spills, Takes from above, gives from below — Time plays and watches. From home it came, returned home — Separate bees and the universe's hive Work like a bagel And the hole in it.

789-9

"What are you hiding? Come on, show me. With whom the correspondence, from whom the letters? The photos will tell Who that goat is. Whether at a party, if not on the beach — I'll figure it out. I'm no donkey." Only girlfriends, no competitors — As if everything's clean. And suddenly a reproachful thought passed: "And what about me personally? Women and girls, old and young In relations I'm free and sharp, But I'm no traitor, I love her, So why the suspicions of her?"

788-8

Scholars will meet in Berlin, Olympians will gather in Tokyo, Unknown yet, who and not now, — They didn't even hold a colloquium, They voiced only the idea, And people already believed in it. To fly together beyond the earth, — Imagination lacks, they consider it a lie, The prophets didn't testify enough. The impossible becomes reality, Accepted as due, So someday we'll collide with infinity too, Having embraced the unattainable boundless.

787-8

Jokes are a serious matter: They'll cheer up, but also kill, One must and can joke: Wisely, not anyhow. So the frail stands up, And the boor sows good: Having broken horns in jokes, Jokingly drove evil from others too. And so no one cries, Let biting irony And cruel sarcasm Depart, like faulty weapons, Like disgusting marasmus.

786-8

I often hear: "The world is cruel", Rarer — "Joyful life", — The deep one sums up In each of us, the so-called "I". The little turtle examines, Gifted from the waves, Where good, where evil, studies, Applying effort. And doesn't suspect that it sees Outside the mirror of being — With hostility it will frighten itself, With friendliness it will be surprised: "What Beauty!"

785-8

From a Chinese woman and a German Born in France, Who ended up in America, What will he call himself? To which nation will he be counted? How will he survive? As an Indonesian Or a tumba-yumba, As a Nigerian, Or maybe a Judas. Yours Or ours, The most justly humiliated? I don't doubt, he'll choose the best — The most promising.

784-8

You are constant care For children and grandchildren, for everything in the world, Endless ideas, purchases, work, For you, who live for others — to live for yourself. You are my inspiration, a piston to action, Meaning in everything around, Gratitude for shared young years, For replacing the old with the new. I grumble, resist, cherish peace, I hide where there's stasis. Her feminine majesty Will make the lazy march in formation.

783-9

To one — everything, and to others — nothing, At first glance — unjust, Less evil should appear, But a ray in darkness is considered a miracle. Among manure a fragrant rose delights, A rainbow — after thunderstorm and rain, A champion is prepared by a great team, Without beetroot — you can't cook borscht. It turns out, nature teaches patience, Smile, why are you sad? To sprout roots from the earth, And you, Cinderella, will surprise in your time.

782-9

Humanity loves, doesn't offend, Breathes happiness, carries good, Bypasses itself And helps To lift the weakened other. In conflicts, like a sanguine, it saves truth, Everyone wins, Who took And who gave, All make peace, no one fights, In courts it doesn't come to filing cases. But when brother rises with pitchforks against brother, Possessed in an evil frenzy, It's time to call the heavenly ambulance, And return God's morality to both, To heal Sapiens in homo.

781-8

Jealousy in dreams, trust in reality — Here it is, true love, With light egoism, yet sincere, Whom it hunts, for them it's the catch. An eternal theme for poems and novels, The memory of the old and children's dreams, Full of surprises and changed plans, Improvisations of frenzied ideas. It bustles, knows no peace, Strives for the ideals of being, On the laurels of bliss love rests, Ready, like a lion, for a new leap.

780-8

Behind the back of grandiose success A fatal collapse hides, Hastily proclaimed as wisdom Suddenly cracks at the seams. God resists the proud, To the humble He gives grace, The haughty will stumble and wince, Today's nobility will be ashamed. So should we not strive, Is effort vain and empty? … The spiritual heads to heaven, The earthly is carried to the cemetery.

779-8

The samurai's sword in the corner by the bed, Not someone's gift, not a souvenir — The dreamed-of weapon of the army leader, Enchants the master since ancient times. The worn plow returned to the forge, It was beaten into sheets And bent in layers Many times. Tempering in ice strengthened the metal So much that it cuts even silence in half. With hammering in the smithy he annoyed neighbors, Undereat and slept little, The blacksmith worked. Why he lived — he found out to the end. He lifted it in his hands, Knelt And not the katana, but with a bow and dignity To you, country, He gave himself. ____ • Katana — a type of samurai sword.

778-7

About the intellect of whales and dolphins Rumors have spread for long, The even-toed in some generation Understood: on land is evil. They returned to the water element, Outwitted the worldwide flood, The orca and sperm whale Don't grieve much for the land. In oceans people disturb them less, Though there are plenty of dangers there too, Leviathans survived and exist, Australopithecus didn't destroy them to the end.

777-2 (:delirium:)

As thread follows the needle, so thought follows the idea It inspires or saddens, Puts the will at "attention" Or forces to flee. It drinks from the source considered faith, Grows into words and deeds, Charitable or extremely lustful It paves the way to glory. The operator-thought is society's achievement. A droplet for the city, For the country, the earth, Among the stars a tiny spark — The universe values it highly.

776-9

Among grasses and trees the children of nature Hold onto mother-earth, Asphalt and concrete stairs of evolution Say: "Now you're strangers to her." From the salon to the plane, by escalator to the mountains, The screen shines with beauties, The phone and computer talk to us, No wives, no children, no mothers. Is the artificial wiser than you? If intellect is from heaven, And the bodily dreams of comfort, Should one surrender to the machine? Let the creation rule the creator?

775-9

Word formation, mosaic, sacred sounds, World-building, strict law — The speaker takes the cosmos in his hands, Shreds and forms his own canon. The likeness of the Creator, like a spermatozoon, Strives to Truth from bottomless depths, Wins immortality in a duel with zero, Jumps to unattainable peaks. The egg cell powerfully awaits, Watches the vault of ladders and towers, The Creator helps man's thought, Word by Word, for He is the Word too.

774-9

Oh, these provocateurs! Cardsharps, tricksters, Deceiver-manipulators, Front-runners. They rush swiftly for cups, Receive the prize, Bite the gold medal. They'll cook borscht — So it doesn't sour, Eat it themselves And let the hungry go. Pioneers-trailblazers — Not always egoists, Don't take only for themselves, Among them there are fine fellows — They'll pave the way, And help us squeeze through too.

773-8

The doctor treats, dispenses the mixture, What to take, How often And when, So as not to fall early Under the surgeon's scalpel, To pharmaceutically avoid trouble. Health invariably Concerns him — He brings To agreement Yin and Yang, Learns constantly, Experiments, While the sick depart To other knowledge. In needs of harmony Without pills and agony Let in mortals resurrect Dark and light, Cold, warmth, Female and male, Earthly and heavenly, So they'd abandon sin, rotten and dishonest, So medics have less work.

772-8

Alarms, alarms! You flee far during the day — I manage to chase you away, You found a target for revenge — At night you don't let me sleep. A conversation with someone, a watched film, The ricochet of a barely noticeable thought Form a squad of nightmares, Shatter reality to smithereens. The body sleeps, The subconscious takes up the watch, Guards, reminds, teaches The loser not to relax tomorrow.

771-8

One beats, seven hold, And suddenly the victim rises in spirit, The attackers flee — The humiliated will rejoice and learn That truth exists in the world. They'll support the weak For will and for might, Everyone loves victory And changes of places. Yesterday's hooligans Are humane like no one. They are you and me. Good is disguised evil.

770-8

Give me, please, A piece of your life — Of energy and time. I'll share mine too. Help and products, Service and goods, A horse for rent, a bay — From me — a fee. If not barter, then cash, A bill of exchange — for a wagon. The best dollar or kopeck Is the standard of exchanging lives.

769-8

The male grabs, the female yields, Both become owners — The continuation of the kin happens, They give life to you and me too. Defeat becomes victory, They caught the submissive — and he caught, For he steps reliably on the road That the frontiersman trod. He draws blessings from one hungry for glory, For glory, but not for shame, So that children and grandchildren will later say: "Grandfathers lived good times."

768-8

The grandson fell ill, the children rushed, They ask to pray to the Lord of powers, The prescribed medicines don't help, So they disturb the family rear. When alarm — run to God, I need Him too. When not to Him, then to whom? For from somewhere the source of Life pulsates. To the indifferent, health "comes by itself", So they think — there is no Creator, Faith for the better never harms, Especially in Providence — without limits, without end.

767-8

He has many women — My love is hopeless, Not for me the wedding wreath, Not for me the wedding dress. To become the only one — no hope, "Come to your senses, Don't burn yourself!" — The treacherous tear reminds again. Though spring rages around, The unopened leaves fall. I surrender, I renounce all claims. You're free, I'm not offended at anyone — I release you And MYSELF. I'll wash off the mascara, smile spitefully. What does "I surrender!" mean? — I'll continue fighting for happiness.

766-6

History is a speculator, A convincing palm reader: If it doesn't steal, it lies. Propaganda's guess, How it was first, Will tune for tomorrow. The system controls, Citizens dream, Sometimes so zealously That Maidans ripen. And I have the right to a version, Similar to truth, To my own personal spice — What I cook, that I'll eat.

765-9

Smoke a cigarette and it'll let go, Drink alcohol and forget. Muffle conscience, let it not torment, Resistance is extra, let them take. As if thought no longer guards the soul, And doesn't call again to the fight. It warns and sounds the alarm: "Concentrate, decide, do!" There was a cause for circumstances, The consequence is also in your hands, Man is called to think, So as not to get entangled in sins.

764-8

A storm. A gusty wind. It begs to levitate. To tear oneself from the earth, To hang, to fly — Secretly, so as not to tempt. Here it is, the ecstasy of freedom, Head and feet at eye level, Independence from gravity… And suddenly I find myself in the shock of sensation, In horror, a generator of super-anxiety. People from around the corner expect evil, They flee from each other. "Calm down, don't be surprised that I'm not like that. I'm not a ghost, I'm not dead! I'm very alive! I crave a truer life."

763-8

The martyrs of the planet Absorbed darkness into themselves, They're not brought bouquets much, For they're prone to onslaught, To hooliganism, rudeness, robbery, Not only among themselves, But also among neighbors. They befriend trouble themselves, And see good in troubles. They carry grief like medicine, Well-being is their enemy. Or maybe pity them? For onto themselves and ours they drag the gloom, To free us from it — To teach where truth is, where evil.

762-0

It's pleasant to meet a smart person, I'll share with them, take from them, I'll laugh, rejoice, rest my soul And encouraged I'll go on. If I run into a boor, I won't flee, Let him teach etiquette to me and himself, Instead of shaming, dishonoring mother, I'll extinguish anger — maybe dignity will accept. Evil and good, stick and carrot Lead pupils in the right channel. Children and old, sober and drunk, They'll perfect us and receive us into the Kingdom.

761-7

Two kopecks are dearer than hryvnias, A kind word, than an angry wallet, Morning dew, than rainy tropics, When a glorious end completes the deed. When widows don't cry and the planet is sated, Children with parents, no divorces, The rocket flies to Mars, not to the house, Quarrels are absent — war is forgotten. The heart in the chest chooses the future, A thought for good, or an idea for evil. Intentions and faith are a mighty beginning, Not such a worthless mustard seed.

760-8

War is a funnel. It sucks in the captured. The beau monde needs a party, The elite wants to carouse. Its possessions are too few, It lacks "action" — It would seize another piece, Not without destruction. Lords argue, Serfs fight. The cruel boast of injustice, The brutalized are lost for salvation.

759-8

Nobody nobody to nobody by nobody Nothing nothing to nothing by nothing Nowhere nohow somehow From nowhere to nowhere never — There are no teachers, no pupils, no school. Someone someone to someone by someone Something something to something by something Somewhere somehow somehow From somewhere sometime somewhere — It became a phenomenon. Learn… Some some to some by some Something something to something by something To some around somewhere Elsewhere somehow sometimes — We'll accept or deny. Each each to each by each Becomes obedient or hostile… All by all to all to all (And to us, and to them) In every way to everyone everywhere Everywhere always from everywhere All of all of all — However sin resisted, God's goal is achieved. As the Testament proclaimed, The world was filled with blessings.

758-9

One is a case, two is a coincidence, Three is a system, four is a law. Where to stop, let conscience say, Or to stretch beyond the horizon. Patience builds will, Breaking relations is a collapse, I want to walk beside you, Firmly holding the path. In stumbles I'll support you, No one will break, no one will fall — Love is the cause for me. Understand me, please.

757-8

Muse… Do I address you correctly? Maybe Idea, an inspired Word? I try to have you beside me, And you nestled to me? How not to scare you away Not to push away your love? You propose to forget everything, To satisfy Only your desires. Maybe you're an idol that destroys fates, Offering a universe for two? Let the Creator hear the creation: I BELIEVE — WITH ME IS GOD!

756-9

I've said everything, let time edit, I filled its slit as I could. Another thinker hunts for meaning, While the exit threshold is still far. He'll investigate himself, won't believe me, To verify is everyone's duty, At the opportunity let him change the idea for the better, Cleanse it from the slag of hostile deception. We seek together in the earthly purgatory, Not competitors, but collaborators, There, beyond the threshold, having shed rags — Whence, we'll understand, and where we are.

755-8

(To linguists about the root TER) The blackthorn clings, stretches behind, The carcass will drag, will tear the soul, The patient will stretch, will disdain lunch, The gum-eraser will erase by dragging. Territory is space stretched by God, Terrace is a stretched house beyond the threshold, Terrarium, terem — a stretched area, An attractive woman and good, When she lightly paints herself, If the mirror moves away or pulls closer. To drag on a grater — to grate carrots, Terror is the action of dragging, A terrorist is one who drags. The stretched term fixes the essence.

754-3

I'm a patriot, I defend the country, I call fellow citizens to battle, If needed, I'll die for it, The worn couch won't let me lie. But today in the district, Where everyone's a stranger, I was updating a conscript's data. And someone on the back On the quota form Confessed ardent love. The questionnaire I see, then a blank page, But the love note where it was, there it is. The clerk confessed — she's that woman, And my mutuality as a married man Through betrayal will cancel my dossier, In a romantic establishment I kiss lips And caress intimate places, I saved myself, but my soul grieves, For conscience just burned to the ground.

753-8

He lies, threatens, beats and steals, As if it was always so, He'll honestly serve, protect, embrace — Everyone heard of such too. Inside lives a zebra, Unreliable, changeable, striped. What emotion will burst from me, I cannot guarantee. I tune myself and neighbors to good, Called to carry light, Forgive me if I again look predatory, I hope I'll finally be sanctified.

752-8

Someone had to pay God, To extinguish His anger, To step onto the scaffold of the insolent, So the sinner would live by hope, Would realize his repentance deeper And cleanse his clothes On the way home. The Lamb chose a marriage with the flawless, Who'll appreciate the sacrifice and hear the call, An eye for an eye and a tooth for a tooth In the New Testament also works, Who laughed and in evil didn't stop, He'll lose salvation From not understanding That with the face of Love David's descendant fortified himself with a shield Not among creation, But before the Creator.

751-4

The cardsharp got the whole world for the game, Conscience long forgotten, A report for crimes hangs over, The poison of lies saves. Aces, kings and queens up the sleeves, A knife behind the sock, prompters all around, Can't do without self-advertising, Falsified witnesses and papers. But what if he really makes us rich, Exactly as he promises? And will revive our grandeur again, If he doesn't lose to Satan.

750-7

A shack in the village, not a house. A poorer place seems not to exist. Beautiful girls around, But here She was born. Here she lived, accepting fate, Friendly with people, honored her parents. My beloved, when I especially yearned for you, I secretly passed by your windows. They called me lost. Despite the fellow villagers, I saw the humiliated as the best, With the scent of lilac and the beauty of roses.

749-8

Flow, streams, Into all worlds — And though a canal is being dug, Clouds will water you, Orchards will drink you, So God commanded, behind Him the final. Sail, loaves, The needy await you, Let them laugh at sincere eccentrics — However you turn it, Blessed romantics: To convert frauds, They're not just polite — They bless in response to anger. They don't strive to own, but to serve, They give left and right, They're easy to deceive, But truth won't forget to repay — Streams carry bread back in response.

748-8

The invader will drive out, kill, deport, Will bring his pack to the seized lair, Will feel like a winner, Explaining that he doesn't steal. Not many years will pass, Descendants will call primordial, With the brand of greedy orcs They'll be branded and cursed. With time they'll stand up in defense From that same horde of theirs, Aren't their own to attack — Let them know where they came from.

747-7

The mysteries of being, encoded in the Word, Continue to live in thoughts and sounds, Flying away, they return again, To compose in knowledge and sciences. They scatter in quarrels and unite together, They lead to wars and reconstructions, They divide into clans and groups, Without tearing from the foundations. Let's argue, to disperse To the edges of the earth and beyond oceans, So that, having met later, sensations and experience Will intertwine more tightly with words, So the code will be fixed more reliably.

746-7

When even small obstacles There's no strength in oneself to overcome, Rocks frighten, steepness, Beyond Rubicon — Rubicons. By the kilogram they demolish mountains, The law is written with words, Grains will fill the granaries, And you'll pile up a Rubicon yourself. Fears will suddenly become funny. "I am a giant!" — the slave will proclaim, Already a lion, not a kitten He'll go across the field of dandelions.

745-8

— How much is two plus three? — Depends on the country. Four where whether you want or not, steal, Six — in the one that doesn't give up its own, Five — in the dictatorship of discipline. And while algebra counts In conditions of peace or war, Who took power rules, Though it devours and rages A horde with the zeal of locusts, Offers zero in the sum, For it hates fullness. Two and two — Four. In appearance — simple arithmetic. Two boards, a nail — the hammer's gone… No one stole it — Truth's mathematics is so.

744-8

Rakes still teach, Forming the thinker. The student's stumbles — five, One stumble — the teacher's. To recognize the reliable, A rung for growth — Here one would need wisdom, But choosing is not easy. Brazen self-confidence, A messenger of egoism, Gathering anger in a fist, Having surrendered to indifference, Will carelessly step into the abyss — It will eat itself.

743-9

A knight at night On a unicorn Through silken grass, Not along the road, In a fairy garden He scatters radiance, Drives away trouble — At first imaginarily. He'll wake up ordinary, But he'll write down the dream. And suddenly he'll shine! He'll go and won't stop — He'll cleanse, whiten, And not the black only, He'll believe in himself, And behind him others He'll call to the dream.

742-9

The unknown frightens. The future lurks Behind the screen. Faith doesn't know, But promises, Looks Sincere. There's something to remember about the lost, Reliable accounts in banks, And tomorrow's not yet seen Waits beyond nights in dawns. Shall we ignore the landmarks, Calls, goals of living? Can't do here without faith — It's desirable to love faith, Faith must be nurtured.

741-9

Photos won't say much, I leave myself in verses. Among better and worse thoughts Let mine too lie into the canvas. They'll encourage doing good, Or push toward crime — I propose living, And consequences — later. They'll agree with me Or condemn — That's how it goes, Worth remembering: Recommendations are many, But the choice is in people.

740-8

Again relations — a bottomless theme. Claims and offenses in a sauce of justice, Defending, a zealous need Not to miss a chance to boast. To boast of what? To humiliate a neighbor? Or to sort out the labyrinths of causes Of the amazing experienced? Yes, I seek benefit, For myself and interlocutors — ways out. From disappointments and emptiness Memory suggests escape options.

739-7

Turn the cheek, let God strike — He won't knock out a tooth, but will strengthen, Will rid bones and body's flabbiness, Will teach how to become gold and flint. Only let the fleshly heart in His palm Humbly receive grace, Love and ineffable joy, For hatred and sorrow will fly away. The past will lie on tablets As testimony of parental wonders, We'll see what comes next, And for now: Christ is Risen!

738-9

Gog and Magog conduct filtration, From them remain The most worthy: The unreliable replenish emigration, Fall under liquidation, Considered their own Are the cruelest. They will manage "to repeat", Around the world they'll find supporters, They'll gather those like themselves Of various breeds of scoundrels. A few more steps to Armageddon — With the world team of orcs By a herd of beasts and animals Satan in a single stream Prepares en masse For Jerusalem.

737-9

Here was a church, now a store. Why pray? Trade flourishes. The lures of shop windows call Without reminders of God anywhere. Except among earrings A cross with inlaid gold Of paths overgrown to faith Remained a distant memory. Money, wealth and grandeur Sweep everything in their path — They deprive settlements of temples, For conscience sold itself to sin.

736-8

Natural selection is merciless to the weak, Mistake threatens derailment, Success awaits the zealous, The ardent builds a nest for the family. A leader comes to power with an idea, With the Quran, with Christ's New Testament, Assures of equality, brotherhood, But self-affirmation is his goal. Under the mask of one inclined to truth With a strong fist He demonstrates around the right of the strong, As if the crucified was a weakling.

735-9

Dreams disturb, friends turn away, And then depression torments. In an enchanted circle find themselves Fury and destructive aggression. Everyone around is guilty, The ego justifies itself. But suddenly — the Word, Unobtrusively again and again, From within educates conscience: "Change yourself, not cunningly, but sincerely, Realize the enemy's needs, Your repentance is the keys to peace, Buy relations and peace for cheap."

734-8

As at first they'll call us heroes, So then they'll dump the blame on us, For everything we with you will commit, We'll make peace, or go to war. Today's beautiful will be condemned tomorrow, The sun-lit will be covered by darkness, The sensation will later be forgotten, We'll look around — we're already gone. Is vanity really the main idea, Chaos and coincidence? The dialectic spiral and the dot where I am Cannot hide the Creator's glory.

733-9

Oh, the house across the river is burning, The drunken neighbor set it on fire. I should save from the fire — They say I influence the world. Let God help the weak, I'm on the side of the strong, Where violence prevails: The bandit and robber are my accomplices.

732-5 (irony)

(A reaction to 709-8) There's no life in her gaze. It, like a wave, has passed. In the soul — emptiness and accelerated suffering. Now also loneliness. For what? For the fact that from poverty she wanted, When the moment ran by, To surrender into captivity to indignity, So then to smoke a hookah, To dress up playfully in trinkets, For it's sweet to live in the mirror. But fate burns like nettle, And in the throat it chokes, hurts. The girl pondered today, Does she need this gold? She'd have lived in the mountains of Frankivshchyna — Though barefoot, but married. Grishchuk Yu.L. 21.12.2025 (And a bit of my co-authorship)

731-7

Wonderful! But praise not me, But the One who gives the Word And the Word. He spreads Him, scatters, Cares for the Word with the word. The calling is granted selectively — At the treasury of spiritual riches I'm counted as Ali-Baba, But let's acknowledge the owner without sacrilege. You liked the verse, it inspires you? Respect for the author was born? Though the writer seeks it, The inspiration is not from his source.

730-8

Decorations often mask the dead, Poisonous for man's salvation.

729-8

Want, deepen the study of Truth, Want, rejoice or fall into depression, But accept the definition for the world: They carry us to the address.

728-8

Look, Europe is next to Ukraine, So it should help Ukraine, And America from across the sea Should supply Europe.

727-8

The nature of peace — The silence of jungles, From accumulated fat The burning of weekdays. The nature of peace — A sated prairie. An abandoned axe, A satisfied empire. The nature of peace — Forgotten claims, Sincere friendship From birth to pension.

726-7

In tandem the wagons and the locomotive Compete, who's more important. Who served people more sincerely For good, Who's truly better, who's worse. Let the head stay in place, Though it seems to dominate, And its words are haughty, But it's worth nothing When there's no body with it.

725-7

724-8

So eggs are laid and broth is cooked, The housewife breeds speckled hens. Wealth grows and the throne strengthens From the number of slave-people. Not for nothing is paradise time a bait After the soul flies beyond the clouds.

723-8

I think — truth is with me, The opponent thinks it's with him, In disputes you can't avoid pain, The threat of becoming a stranger to kin. Then maybe in patience the hostility will disappear, When truth with time herself Will reconcile us — will come to meet us.

722-7

I sorted out, swept, sorted, Not the garage and not the house, but my own soul — What I could, I comprehended and described, But I must live on. Let the wind scatter, and the rains wash away — Dry matches and hydrants on lawns. We reveal reserves we didn't even know about, — Talents are added to talents.

721-6

The nail said: "I did it," Though the finger deserves the credit. Someone praised the hand, But hid in the sleeve The true hero is the forearm, Where there — the shoulder, When taking higher. 720-9

To justify truth white or black They launch counter-propaganda, As a result of a treacherous storm They receive destructive karma. Tense situations Start wars. 719-9

Had a goal? Did you reach it? If so — emptiness Hang like a banner. Like a victory flag Crowned with glory In a road's dead end. The mission is finished. Mission is not achievement, But only an approach, A striving for eternity — A trace for others.

718-8

A hunter of dreams From another reality Pulls ideas. With non-standard thoughts In their instructiveness He composes trophies. You are not you. And the prey is gifted to you. 717-9

Trouble when they expect The earthly and nothing more. "No sense!" — they cry before death. Without faith it's much worse to depart, Without it the choice is only to die, But with faith they go to resurrect.

716-9

Someday others without passes, at once Will go happily through the tunnel, Saving shoes and time, For long miles will shorten. Though in abundance and strength, They don't even remember Miners in the mile.

715-5

Conception and death Excite differently. In through-stitching Birth and disappearance away. It appeared — To seize. It yielded, To free. More is formed by less, A cell becomes a body. The last — again the first… …For a fuller whole The soul flew.

714-8

The alarm vibrates again: "Enough sleeping, rise, get up To usual routine tasks — With enthusiasm or complain. Decide yourself whether joy or sorrow Will lead by the hand during the day." 713-7

712-7

There lived Adam, The garden was enough, But he felt lonely, Himself became too little. He has a wife now, She needs a lot — He cares for his half, More than for himself. Whence to add Comfort in comfort? Easy to guess — From Adam at work.

711-4

The formed ball plays with axes, For no one will cancel the first cause To ice and to warm, To deaden and resurrect again, To develop nature, to form man, Offering rhythm and rhyme in experience, To paint the picture of world-building.

710-8

War broke families, Maimed fates, You can't drive the predator out of man, He constantly craves blood. Having suffered insane losses, He dreams of righteous revenge. 709-7

708-8

rfia is "mighty" here too — It changes Ukrainian spelling. In the surname pu — a part is missing, Like rust or chaff, sediment or oxide. The stronger the thought in Ukraine, The faster raisia will break its teeth.

707-8

So it's convenient to learn by heart, And the truth doesn't prick too much. Let them correct me again: What's worse about BAABAB or BBAABB?

706-8

705-8

704-6

(To blogger Dmytro Kravchenko-2)

703-8

702-7

But you have more ability — Receive the power of the Word.

701-8

By the Word and in the Word, Losing and giving birth, I accept myself — Coming to the dot, I start again.

Into an endless flight We'll turn the dot.

A multitude of angels. Battle at Donetsk. The first. The aggressor with a sword Grows. Disgust. Armies grimace and fear. Let everyone understand — The stone flies.

691-8

690-8

And thank two legs too, That walk everywhere — here and there, There are people who live without them, Why are you silent, lucky one? I agree with you about the mess, And that far from all is right, But think well amid hardships, Value what you already have here. (At my sister's request — a translation from Russian of her favorite song "Say Thank You to God Before Sleep")

686-8

684-0

683-7

Should I too to the opposite ones Rewrite the commandments and testament?

682-7

681-8

Aggressive cultural siege — Let's save ourselves with dignity, Let's drive them out while we can.

(Trilogy. 678th — 680th) The situation is known — As a guest — not at home, And the orphan accepted into the family Is constantly grateful and dependent… Without shelter and at least a corner The immigrant has no full rights, His behavior is cautious. Trying to become kin, Useful and opportune, The newcomer carries timid alienation As healing humanity — To the haughty, but spiritually poor.

678-9

Permissiveness hasn't faded yet, Intrusive slogans don't fall silent: "Don't punish your son, you're a democrat, And don't wound him with unpleasant lectures. Isn't man a brother to man? Or maybe let the wise and God-fearing, Resolute but calm, Let the balanced be given power? Dictatorship is certainly evil, But chaos is also the people's misfortune.

677-9

The rich imperishable soul, Having given away the perishable to the ground, Kept only a chipped chest With treasures inaccessible to decay. In the middle of the night a small candle Became a lamp on the altar Not under the table, but high above, A life-affirming testimony Of enormous growth. The mortal will say: "It's gone, for it burned. Such is the end of each of us. God has no business with us": "Truly it shines," — the living won't lie. 676-9

It's not too late to re-park, Closer and safer. God protects the careful. Time to understand how to choose, To postpone again, Or to load already. Flags are stuck, zones marked, Here trust, and there a cliff, Here I found, And there it was lost, For I thought wrong and did the wrong thing. Experience holds wagons on the track, And what I'd always wish for myself, That the switchman doesn't oversleep, And doesn't send On the wrong trajectory.

675-8

Controversiality is a condition for seeking truth, Unipolarity — Falling into extremes. Light and vibe are gifted by sparks, Their nature is the presence of contradictions. Here a thought woke up in bed — A new day demands movement, They woke us to feats, They lit the sun again, Our nearest star. Time to get up — the struggle awaits.

674-8

A bird, a dog or a cat, A mouse, a bug or a viper Will replenish the devastated world That parting robbed. I must seek temporary solace, Greedily I catch the animal gaze… If only to remember And to love My own soul, That always, Wherever you go — Is relentlessly nearby.

673-7

I'll go to those better than me, Holier and nobler, Impure straight to heaven I'll crawl not on all fours — they'll carry in carriages. Am I a scoundrel? The noble become dirty from me, And I won't touch the dirty for anything? So maybe I'll help you with something?

672-8

Execution is severance from the recently whole, Division of it into parts and fragments, Liquidation of the free by the predator, Peaceful разборки won't help. The savanna's sympathy is enjoyment of the show, For the victim won't stand up Neither elephant nor hippopotamus. No one's interested in exposing themselves, With horns that screw between ribs — True salvation for herds. The lion is hungry, but the bull Also wants to live. If not him, then whom To defend himself and his own?

671-9

On lined paper The old generation with a two Piled words In neat handwriting And read to us solemnly — We listen politely, barely holding laughter: Very primitive — not printed, Without artificial intelligence, Talentlessly rhymed, Violating etiquette. The audience is embarrassed, Someone laughs. But grandma loves as she can, She mangles, but from the heart.

670-8

A filled-up well gives no water, Renouncing faith paralyzes, The absence of morality rebels, The unwise apostate beats himself, Doesn't accept healthy advice and doesn't hear. In the status of evil and unhappy After lunch he'll come to you too, Having freed himself from his own good, To free others' good too.

669-8

He took away toy cars, Broke his little sister's dolls, Fought and teased, Stole cigarettes unnoticed While dad slept. A hero. 668-2

Life experience aloud Words speak and write. Before the ear crumbles, The scythe cuts the stalk. I drink from the root, I drink myself full of sun, I submit to the higher will — The straw in the field will be revealed as the winner, And the grain in the barn.

667-7

I live again.

666-8

To be yourself takes strength, Which later brings good fruits — A person cheerful and happy. But enemies envy him: "How's that — he lives as he wants? Duties choke us, To remain free is a crime, And let them make him suffer!" They write denunciations, deprive of property, Stick snouts into the dearest — So the soul rises higher, So it spreads its wings wider.

665-7

The bigger the fool, the bigger the experience, The more bumps on the forehead. Let the guests boast first, I'll learn from them when I get a chance. Scars and fractures Of my own are enough, Mistakes I also made plenty. The best-baked knows best, Better let him speak. He's a hero, for he extinguished the fire, And saved children from trouble, Climbed a high tower, But better he'd take away the matches.

664-8

Why Christ, if there's no resurrection? Unneeded are churches, synagogues and mosques. Do generations live to die — For the triumph of "almighty" death? They gathered to deny Life, Give everything to perdition — They'll surely have to cross out Even the fact that they live.

663-7

I avoid being zombified with slander, I crave the Holy Spirit's guidance.

662-5

In the chase for money, here are competitors. The favorite business — friends and fruits, Not excessive profit percentages, Not spies and not counterparties. Enjoy, create and live. Not papers, not metal and not stone, But precious treasures of the heart Resistant to fame's lures — Her kisses are dangerous. Greed in finances And experienced arrogance — Attributes of lordship, But expect trouble.

661-7

The cube crumbled to dust, The pyramid's top collapsed, A tooth has to be pulled, But those aren't your troubles. For you to accept and for you to grow, Someone must pay for it. So there's somewhere to come to, The place must be freed by The young one Who defends the country, And I, the old one — Burn out. Time for the next shift — Live. I bless you.

660-7

Grinding and smoke, flashes and sparks, The bonfires of disputes — glory to Him.

659-7

How handsome we are, cool, special, Though we pull in different directions! Deceived, but happy. Steps to everyone's benefit. We'll answer alone, Cellmate friends: Criminals will wait for forgiveness, The righteous without masks will disappoint.

658-8

They ask for positivity, oblivion from suffering, Start about the cheerful — betrayal. About the fulfillment of hopes — Truth doesn't always grow. We balance between good and evil, Between slyness and sincerity, We hide, then push head-on, Covering fear with cunning. Blind to trouble, busy with ourselves. We play golf, write verses, Dragged into comforts by indifference We live while others die.

657-9

On tiptoe on the big toe A pirouette begs — Worthless in the ordinary waltz He tears into classical ballet. The spinning top laughs at challenges With perfect balance. Under shouts of "Bravo!" — To the end and with inspiration. I can't, But I really want to. They say I don't dare, But I'll slip through.

656-7

A rainbow appeared, divided the sky, Pushed clouds and storms into the tunnel — They now look like exterior, Instead of watering cans and ceilings. Sun and light we finally have, Fresh air, ozone. But again in a week we await rain, For the season is too hot. People always complain, They're too cold, then too warm. That's why they're not asked And not marked in the changes, Where's heaven and where's hell.

655-8

Jesus of Nazareth is a deceiver to the world, Fantasy, invention, myth, A dispute among young and old, Devoutness and humiliating laughter. They seek the Universe's Lord everywhere, On continents and islands, Everywhere where it's lonely and crowded, So also in the air, on seas and in seas. Christ and Buddha, Moses' God and Zeus Helped more than one generation — The heavens' care enveloped earthlings. Where, it would seem, a trap, It's hard for a son without a father, For creation without the Creator.

654-8

Alas, borders are marked with blood, Not forever and not for eternity. Neighborhood with love doesn't work out, Though mountains and rivers try — Isolating one's own and another's, They reconcile for a while, Until hatred grows, To push ridges and move estuaries. But the planet looks unified from afar. Among other cosmic bodies With its nature, particularly with man — Lem's Solaris with its contradictions.

653-9

Past, present and future Have their components. Events real or absent Are conveyed in the word. A constant process or a fragment, The deed finished or continued, Divided into fragments or multiplied, Millennia or a moment. The probable, impossible and desired, The contrived and the fact — Conditionally laid out in tenses, To feel the taste of being.

652-8

For slaves the elite family Chooses from among itself a leader To rule over the rabble. But what if there are no poor, Others have factories, and I have a farm? We exchange profits, Welfare grows, The country flourishes, But we notice, When we look around, The freeloaders drool around, Their envy and fury at the rich burns, We need protection. For the city, the state a reliable sheriff To stop evil robbers, Ours and others'. A strong-willed overseer, not a vegetable, Not a priest-tsar, but a guard.

651-8

At night I learned a lot, I'll try to sleep in the daytime too, Especially since today is Sunday, I laid out the chaotic thoughts, Hope appeared clearly, It didn't do without inspirations. Zombies work without rest, Meanings in fog, mountains of duties. Sometimes you need to make a stop, To hear what God says. For fullness Much isn't needed. Leave the earthly to earth, Focus on the soul — Treasures To gather for heaven.

650-8

They go to the sea for rest To relieve the weekdays' tension Away from work and their own house With corrections for enemies and best friends. To stir the frail, to calm the tired, For children to run around, for old to sit, To encourage the shamed, In the too bright to dim the fire. Waves, as mediators Between water and land, Of course, with heaven's participation, Will take away the unneeded, Will give the necessary, I accept as is, I don't force anything — They'll cleanse me and remember you.

649-8

They say, to research is to stop living. For the participant to become an observer, To step out of the test tube to look into it… To end up nearby, It turns out, with the Creator? To refuse to remain a game, For a pawn it's not like being a queen, Having dodged attack and battle, To sit at the board as a player. What claims? Floors Everyone chooses themselves: Physically or mentally They're played, or they play. And playing, Not quitting the game, Doesn't life reach A greater level?

648-9

They carry crosses differently. Cheerfully having thrown it on the back, Some manage to drag it, Someone'll quit entirely. The born are given rights, So missions are fulfilled, In duties — the cross And a certain dose of strength. Having lifted to the sky by the sides And opposed to all winds, No need to carry the cross anymore — It'll carry. Like a hang glider.

647-8

Language divides the country. Does Kazakh divide Kazakhstan? Ukrainian — Ukraine, Azerbaijani — Azerbaijan? Moldovan — Moldova, Latvian — Latvia? Russian "unites" peoples, If they don't want — it'll force, From it only "good, no harm", Everything foreign it'll russify. With genocides and provocations, Repressions and deportations, Holodomors and wars It'll make us free. It'll denazify, Appropriate and finish destroying.

646-9

My brother saw five stars, And my sister — four. Everyone's a bureaucrat. A dispute boils, Where's the millet, where's the buckwheat, To reconcile them, They connected me. I looked left — two, I noticed six on the right. I don't fly as if in a dream, Imagination in place. No delusion, no doubling. Try yourselves — Go figure it out. I watched long, peered, Through a complex system, Until I lined up in a line, One star, Bright!!! Gathered into Glory!!! In Bethlehem.

645-5

I'd wave my arms And fly — Not with my sins Not with the weight of sins. The sky is for swallows And nightingales. Where do I go After the birds. I remembered the crows, Kites with vultures. They're considered evil, Participants in robberies. And am I worse? They can, so can I, Think, I'm sinful. Everyone's like that — With beaks, with claws. My kin, Wait! I'm with you!

644-7

Putin is *the "Moses who leads his great people to the promised land"*, Having turned Truth upside down, Saying the Lord changes the laws. Kill, steal and lie, Covet another's good, Humiliate mother and old father — For greater holiness sin more. Light at night where the drone exploded. A cloud by day where ruins smoke — Gog and Magog, Armageddon Bring huge changes. (the wife refused to evaluate, she didn't like it)

643-0

The eyes sparkled, cheeks reddened, He became talkative, or suddenly fell silent, The gaze runs, palms sweat. Love forms the evil and the saints. To possess, to tear off, to enjoy, To leave the withered and mow further, Having trampled one's own, to aim at another's, To ruin oneself and him. Or to meet one's half, Holding hands, to go together, Having realized the God's human in oneself, To rush to the finish together and carry.

642-8

Trouble flew over the roof, But the neighbor wasn't lucky — It damaged the house. Maybe it's strange to someone — We suffered together, Not only he. His grief is hardship for me too, Doesn't heaven watch humanity? Won't it overturn mine too, Enraged by my indifference? To gloat in another's suffering — To open the gates to one's own, In mutual aid, in shoulder support — Our common work.

641-8

With ego left from the egg-yaytse It suits the chick To teach the hens — And to demonstrate Life's potential. Let it try, gain confidence To spin the universe, But experienced wise should avoid Harmful jealousy, Stopping children, To resurrect in them As a renewed phoenix. The mission isn't finished, admit, The peak of hopes not reached yet. Push the young one, don't hold back — Pass the baton and don't spare.

640-9

Stages of war are like grades in school, One must pass to get a diploma — In the epicenter, in the rear, abroad To choose between evil and good. To let the dictator establish himself, To agree to become a slave, To give oneself to propaganda for attack, To die as an invader, a dog. To save yourself and the closest family, To calm down, to recognize opportunities, To protect the country from invasion With healthy and wise activity.

639-8

I'm jealous, but I don't show it, Maybe I fear spoiled relations, So that with just one suspicious phrase I don't lose fate's gifts. Stealthily She's preparing for a date, Not for nothing She picked the best dress. Is temptation really of such significance To start a fire of scandals? I'll get ahead. I'll save the family — I'll share love with the rival. I'll bless the traitress, Praise her charm: Let her imagine him, but make love with me.

638-5

A fairy tale will help the little one, Introduce him to parents' problems — Kotigoroshko, Little Red Riding Hood, Kolobok and the magic wand Will defeat the dark forces. Humanity reached for space, Not abandoning the cradle-Earth, For Chronos still restrains, Instructing in legends and myths. To the Incas, Japanese and Greeks, As to children, worlds opened. Truth is still far. To it grow and grow.

637-8

Speak, my heart, though reason rebels. If I won't do, at least I'll know. Twice unhappy is the blind who also doesn't hear — If I won't apply, at least I'll have. Where's my holiness, which I proclaim? Not seen in deeds, not worth seeking? I lay hints from prayers into the foundation, So as not to build on sand. The foundation must endure, Tested by an earthquake. I'll pass the exam of faith, And finish the walls and roof with Jesus.

636-8

Honey sticks, begs to be licked, July carries pollen in the air, Resin sticks — water won't seep, Dough sticks — a tasty pie. The unwashed body sticks to the sheet, Fingers stick to large bills, Eyes stick to the Carpathian autumn, Ears stick to the overture's play. The tongue sticks to the throat from thirst, Mud sticks to pants and shoes, Offense sticks from curses and contempt, The born sticks to life's mystery.

635-5

Careful! A sharp turn! However many times I drove here, I experienced unpleasant adventures, I only lacked trouble. So the roads converged, And a tree grew on the corner. To admit myself guilty I hope I'll learn someday. If a schemer-interlocutor suddenly happens, Better for me to brake — Avoiding long quarrels, Not to ram the trunk, but to bypass.

634-2

The Lord breathed and the soul became alive, With the air the rhyme brought ozone, Filled reality with meaning, beauty — Pleasant to surrender to its captivity. The verse factory is not an end in itself. They don't force themselves to breathe. In the cups of thoughts poetry's intoxication, Like nectar they keep, don't shake it. There are many sources of inspiration. Maybe someone'll say I'm speculating — Everyone chooses their own, I breathe verses, don't fabricate.

633-9

Renounce the cosmos's influence, Aliens in different realities, But you can't avoid describing The sky in its boundlessness. Earth is on the universe's palms, Even squeezed in a fist, Won't avoid the census — Though as a grain, will be counted. We watch the stars through telescopes, Not to mention planets, So don't we ourselves belong To the archives where we're also objects? Above the head and underfoot The world and worlds. As if we're owners, But we're also owned.

632-8

The sinner went to fight for truth, The saint calls to love evil, The church forces to bypass itself, But Holy Scripture hasn't changed. The sly Levites sold themselves to mammon, Gather the alien and shear money, Sheep in folds mixed with wolves, They read prayers And sing psalms, The blind lead the sightless to the pit. Life is an exam, a thorny road. Cassocks and vestments are just a masquerade, Only conscience without poisonous advice will understand: Who accepted Satan renounces God.

631-9

I read and forgot. As water flowed through the tap, As the wind blew out the candle, As a snowflake became a droplet. What's the point of talking? For the planet to spin around its axis? To fly into a black hole, So everyone finally becomes nothing? From flash and fading the piston works — The passenger hurries home, Someone'll miss a thought, or hear a word — Will correct the aim at the target.

630-8

Part of humanity's history Wasn't stolen, it was replaced. What was, was. Participants — material. Descendants were taught mankurtism, They raised a pedestal to the leader. Manipulations are also history, Rewritten textbooks, The crowning of grief with glory, Heroes are collaborator-defectors. Only conscience remains, Memory unclouded, A tale pressed into the subconscious, Sent to God's judgments.

629-8

The Lord's day is a day of rest, A break between days — sleep Periodically makes a stop, So that at least for a minute The Holy Spirit's fine linen touches. So between cares and sorrows A gap suddenly breaks through — "Peace to you," quietly said The consequence and the first cause. Sleep and Saturday — Halts on the long road. Yes, work is also needed, To find peace in God.

628-8

The world fusses, unravels tentacles, Reaches for heights and latitudes, Doesn't give up, won't yield to the elements, To win is a care of cares. But the embryo in the embryo froze motionless, In microscopes it can't even be discerned, Where that Beginning is, still unknown, The eternities' rebuses play with us. Boys fight, measure strength, Girls lack love, The tentacle and the embryo Will surely win — The masculine and feminine beginning.

627-8

Recognize the genius in yourself Among haters, Don't drown, you're a float. Think, a turbulent current, There'll be a quiet corner for you without risks At the shore. Somewhere they hunt whales in the ocean, Fly to space, rake millions, Build skyscrapers in Dubai, And you were endowed with no small essence. Wait on the surface, ready to dive, Hold on above to the bridge, Prepare for the tug from below of the catch, For the fate-fisherman's jerk.

626-8

He strangled ants, Stole in the shop, Smashed neighbors' windows, Lied to parents. He sorted through mistresses, Fell in love with untruth, Robbed others', Headed a gang. He bought courts, Multiplied corruption, Seized posts, Raped the constitution. The people envied him, Took him as an example. The whole country got used To such a prank. They break every commandment, They hate one Another, Threaten and intimidate, Don't notice the hungry. Everything for the flesh, There's no God for them, And then they're surprised — Where's the war from?

625-8

Enough politics, Time to rest from the war, Let's talk about food, weather or sport. Tired of criticism, Let's test the skill of loving, Forget about discomfort at least a bit. Politics in the kitchen In the proportions of spices, At work and in church, In frost and in heat, In the park or in the gym it's again there. Psychology and physics, Drama and lyrics — Struggle everywhere. You can't hide from cares — Even in dreams the irritants annoy. You'll have to accept and not resist: I and circumstances are constant companions.

624-9

Hold-up! You gave us your hat, Wallet, all credit cards, Transferred the business, The car and other belongings, But you won't let the "chicks" go? We warned kindly — We only cut off 3 fingers, You're messing with our heads. Forget about the country, language and faith, Don't act like a militarist. We liked you, so share sincerely. You resist And defend yourself? Oh you Nazi!!!

623-7

A belated thought Doesn't want to throw itself as feed to pigs. It'd like as an arrow, and with a tip Exactly at the target even in storm and tempest To fly as a rider launched at gallop. It dreams to itself, having read books, Having watched films about ideals, But Don Quixote didn't make it there either, Now he overslept and missed again. There are no horses, they forgot about bows and spears, But one can feel like a genius, A keyboard will suffice — Just poke the right button with a finger.

622-8

— I love you. ❤ — And I — you not. ❌ Means, no reciprocity. 🏃 — I'd wish you gave yourself to me, 🎬 Having given up independence. 🕸 — And I'm looking for another 👀 With absolutely the same goal: 🥅 To have him as obedient, 🧎 And not become his slave. 🗽 — So maybe we'll somehow agree? ❓ I'll become yours, and you mine, 🤝 And you and I will agree to sacrifice,🔥 Calling ourselves a family of lovers? 👩 👨

621-2

An interrupted thought, an unfinished text, Trust in poisonous rumors, And a sincere advice of suspicions Paint my portrait In advance. I'm not like that, but on the screens Of pleasant expectations about me I end up in bruises and wounds. And expect persecutions too. I provoked And allowed Misfortunes to break through — To share happiness I turned to friends. I trusted the wrong ones, Didn't account for The weakness of the floodgates — Or should I complain about myself?

620-5

"When they curse, bless" — Easy to say from the side. Spread a carpet for the scoundrel? Don't dare! Nip evil at the root! Forbid! For the blasphemer and his accomplice. If I echo the aggressor, he'll go further, Swallow and lick his lips, And won't deign to think "sorry". A burned conscience doesn't repent. Even when he crucifies Christ, — Around they weep, but she smiles. The conscienceless can't be forgiven. But He who descended from heaven, Even killed, rose again, To bless.

619-9

Everyone belongs to a line of killers, And belonged before — Great-great-grandfather or grandfather fought once, Killed for freedom, watched the borders. You won't find a peaceful line anymore, Man sinned since Adam. Seeking peace, wherever you go — You take a scythe And a pitchfork. Memorandums aren't trusted. To protect yourself and relatives You must remain a beast, So as not to become easy prey.

618-8

I hope not to be deceived. The earth will remain a jug, Poured in and poured out — I go to eternity. I'll look back — embroidery with a cross, At times I brought happiness, at times trouble again. As they stir water, as they knead dough, As they burn bonfires and extinguish fire, The Angels grew hungry, want to eat, Time to come out as bread from under God's palms. The struggle in the body is to escape death, Trash didn't serve as wealth for long. The little cross reminds that one must die, To be born into a higher life.

617-8

They'll write not about me at all. They need their own image. The bright they'll turn into dark, They'll inflate the plot of events. Or they'll hide facts, Draw what doesn't exist, And tomorrow will come to meet A crown, madness or prison. And at life's parade, However ardently I resist, They'll decide at a meeting My place at quarrels. So who am I really? A cloud in different projections.

616-8

Behind the bars Of the cage Birds sing, Freedom calls to them, No lock, No doors Can be found, Nature mocks the prisoner. I caught the feathered, Kept them in captivity, Stole their sky, Bound, Sold, But now I found myself in their role — The Supreme court caught up with him too. He left no exit, And welded shut Every crack… He asked forgiveness For the cruel guilt, Didn't implore, didn't beg… So finally decided: "I'll smash what I can, and die myself."

615-9

The pleasant snoring of the beloved, Everything he does is a masterpiece, They dragged him home drunk — Here he is in bed, my lion. I'll take off his shoes and undress him, Wipe his dirty body, I reach for him with my soul, I'll kiss him, embrace him. People don't understand: "Why put up with such?" I can't help myself — I love him and that's it. (The wife refuses to evaluate this intrigue)

614-8

A map and compass, A route and backpack, Advice from experienced friends — Proof of seriousness, Guarantees of an easy hike, That overcome any obstacle. They wait impatiently, Call and await At the final point Success, praise and reward. A chance arises to plant The pilgrim-seed In the best soil In the loosened bed. Spread, path, Accompany, clouds, — The journey is not close. For the Christian soul There's a need for support Of mother-earth and father-sky.

613-9

I have no time for trifles, The main calls me, I'm a fourth-grade pupil, The game won't go on without me. I don't tie bows, They won't let me ride, I won't tell you about algebra, I'm furious at girls. My sister reads a book, Mom and dad hurry to the dachas, My little brother lies in bed. I run, for the ball awaits.

612-8

The spiral of the golden section From the well of beginnings beyond the stars' limits — A logical explanation of chaos and disorder, A sprout from non-being to Being. Interested in history? I penetrate the shaft, Until the pelvis gets stuck or wide shoulders, Never having felt contact with zero, Of absolute emptiness. Her underfoot and on the needle's tip Despite the lack of intellect and the eyes' blindness With boundlessness together into eternity's length The Creator united, as nothing and fullness.

611-8

You're not like everyone. You walk your road. People are angry at you, But you're needed by God. As you are. Ivan, Peter or Judas. Yes, life beats you, Tightness from everywhere. They say you're going to hell… With countless warnings You don't drop the cross, you carry it — God appointed you to remain yourself.

610-9

As in the alarming times Of Batu's locusts If they don't build walls The Poles, Ukrainians and Lithuanians, Europe will wash in blood, Will also lie in trenches, Having experienced the horrors of war. Portugal and Spain, And with them Italy, In the corner Britain, And above Scandinavia Slowly come to their senses, That Vikings and Slavs are Their shield. Asia stopped. With two seas And the horde squeezed Will they join their projects? Or will they count the heroes and the present ones Among the shadows of forgotten ancestors?

609-8

A happy woman looks beautiful. Someone took care of her beauty. So she'd feel loved, He fed, Clothed, Kissed And… Respected. In the greenhouse Orchids grow, The soil and tropical climate enriched them, All privileges — Conditions in paradise, not in closed walls. I pick — it withers, I water — it blooms. I love, I cherish, I care. Happy and beautiful. She walks gracefully — I rejoice myself and others admire.

608-8

Civilization under the microscope With its collective intellect In the spyglass and binoculars Tries to discern us too. It toils over the cosmic project How to survive, to warn the crash. But we their galaxies with a needle's tip Instantly shatter with chaos. For us — in a second, For them — in billions of years. Their prophets will extol the lab assistant As the universe's author. But we're also far from the Creator, We hunt among stars — in vain. In imaginations of heaven and hell Though consider that He's not. Let's not deceive ourselves, He's everywhere, Every moment. Admit it, people.

607-8

A key without a padlock is a useless trinket, And why a lock without a code-key? As between evil and good, between them a bond — The soul depends on the idea-key. Temptation inclines it to crime, Conscience guards property and honor. He owns who has access, Having separated his own and another's. I'll fence the gate or let the column through, Protect from trouble or cause a crash, Turn the key left or right — Death or salvation in my hands.

606-9

With successfully played roles The deceived husband is happy, But in sick suspicions and fantasies The jealous withers beside the faithful. They won't laugh at the cuckold, And the betrayed won't cry, Marriages won't fall apart, In mutual hypocrisies all the more. As if they reached the goal To constantly behave sweetly, But nature has, however you twist it, The awl to climb out of the bag.

605-9

A snake or a bumblebee, I didn't see under the leaves, Or maybe sin stung? In safety I lost vigilance, I was careless about others', But my own — no laughing matter. Yes, doctors are at hand. I'll probably run to them. But first I'll sort myself out — Where I crossed the line. From medicines the tumor will subside, The causes, however I guess, I'll never learn, unless He hints Who sent the signal.

604-9

So far and close, Is and isn't simultaneously. Life burns out so fast, But hasn't faded yet. Ours — mine and another's, Mortal — in fact eternal, Nowhere and never — here and now, The everyday and the unusual coexist. The atheist is right about zero and absence, But the church bell rings! Empty past and full future — He is omnipresent.

603-9

Another's is attractive, one's own is reliable… Temptation caresses to the very center of happiness, Good if it leaves by morning like a dream, But what if you can't free yourself from it? It'll whisper that I'm special, — Let the stinkers know who's the alpha male… The treacherous flees from true good, Swift and sudden is his end. I choose with my serf girl Together to break through to the kingdom, Than with another's rich woman To drag into worthless slavery.

602-9

Matches and a razor in humanity's cradle Deliberately planted, or accidentally? Intellect and curiosity fight for experience, So the new Word opens. Pain, Fire, Blood and Blaze. Lessons cruel, but no way without them. Atom, Electricity, Internet-Network, A maniac hungry for power. The most dangerous shapes the best — Let's learn, brothers and sisters, Not to burn ourselves, and with us the rest. We hope Daddy controls us?

601-9

The opponent boils — let him let off steam. Quarreling is a bad habit, Adding firewood and a clamped lid Don't calm the strife. I'll cool down myself, the enemy will calm, The conflict's relevance will disappear, Anger will scatter like gunpowder, And hatred will subside with time. When Cain fears himself, He hides the axe far from trouble. In patience from wars he'll learn peace, And the Lord's mercy won't pass by.

600-9

Lyrics are ashamed, embarrassed, They startled all the nightingales. In the news anxiety, evil rages, Joy fled to better worlds. Music plays, bars are overcrowded, Curfew is about to start. Clouds thicken in the black sky, People hurry to corridors and basements. They enjoyed the day, gathered light, Turned away from victims and ruins. Only a lonely rose bloomed on the flowerbed — Ignored the mine explosions.

599-9

(Sarcastic) Don't divide into west and east. Malorossiya is a single country, Speak only Russian. The native one is not for Ukraine. Don't divide into west and east, Surrender together to the orcs, You'll suffer more troubles, Wider bloody streams. Don't divide into west and east, The Kremlin liberates you From language, freedom and cities — Luhansk and Donbas await you.

598-8

An accidental hostage with a pierced forehead, I continue to live, having accepted pain, Sharing suffering with the unbeaten people, With fragments of dreams and hopes. Once again I receive a bullet Not in the chest, not in the leg, but again in the forehead, And at the edge of consciousness I clearly hear: "What to do with him so he's gone?" Abel is omnipresent here too — Who hits me kills himself. It turns out I'm immortal — The truly tortured lives.

597-9

To see the soul — That's what my correspondence is for. I read yours and must Show mine up close. Someone will understand the music, Someone needs words, Someone focused on a button — Beauty attracts in it. Even when ignored, It didn't get worse, but easier: They paint a self-portrait of thought — I look into the mirror.

596-8

Shards of love and its echoes Didn't become trash of losses and failures, Gathered into experience, like withered cornflowers, Turned weeping into marital idyll. Purity of relations is a scent in a flask. Let the caligulas laugh at the lack of debauchery. Their crows in the sky and driven horses, Not love, but poison in their lips' kisses. Family coziness and mutual trust Are given to us, you and me. Not in vain do Shakespeare's hints teach: Better a flask than a pile of dung.

595-9

In trouble and grief beauty remains, They stone it, rape it, tear it, Through tears it smiles, Arousing even greater fury in the executioner. Not to succumb to untruth, Not to die, to survive — Means to win, To tear out imperialism's sting with the root, Having detained evil, and save others. The ghoul puffs up, goes out of himself, Craves the gopnik's bloody glory. He'll burst from "greatness", neutralize himself, Having splattered the peace they never knew.

594-9

The gopnik tests For weakness and indifference, Forces to resist. He organizes the forces of good, Strengthens their fellowship, So at least a reproach accumulates. They hope for his repentance, For the conversion of the spoiled conscience, Compensation for damages — While courage is lacking. Until a brave one is found Not inclined to violence. Good if he acts wisely: Will speak and stop evil.

593-9

You'll gather emotions in a day, Light, sounds, thoughts, Smells, touches, food portions — The last step leads to bed. The full bag Must be emptied, Pour the earthly up to heaven, Having taken a lesson of experience — Pollen for the bee-soul. Duties pushed, desires pulled. Why did you live, what did you achieve? I gathered for the Creator, whom they forgot, I sought Him Whom I once knew.

592-9

The old teach the young, Leaving experience to descendants — The empty are awaited above, To hand over to higher riddles. Children correct parents — The missed catches up with high schoolers. And from small teachers The wise sometimes hear voiced. Student and professor on both sides, A mixed category. They give and take lessons The department and the auditorium.

591-8

I wouldn't even know who lives in me, Who breathes through me, feeds me, Who really carries whom, What it desires, where it steers, Had I not looked into the soul. Not the enemy's, the friend's, but my own. Not so lost, But not beautiful either — Which I must tend. Whether I speak or listen, Write a verse or read — I stop it, Or move with it, As I accept the word, Or don't let it in.

590-9

Surrounded by evil, By its rituals, I plan to hatch for holiness, Having parted with the priest And his cardinals With the lust for power In their zeal. Before freedom the last duty: "From the sinful choose the most worthy." I gain the answer through a narrow gap — The Lord offers the most weightless. Humanity will continue to bear penance, With hope on a grain of sand, Not on medicine, but on poison, Not on man and not at all on woman.

589-9

Ubiquitous egocentrism Gives rightness to everyone, Avoiding crookedness Unites teams in the similar. Alcoholics, sport, Scientists, politicians Unite in different spheres — Masters of practice and sophistry, Specialists on paper. Personal confidence Enriches the public. Weak limitation Grows into strong.

588-8

The crane builds, the bulldozer destroys, The flower smells, but the stem pricks. The fridge freezes, the boiler heats — What here is good and what is evil? Everyone is useful — the wise admits, The outraged fool will throw away half, Will renounce, shame and condemn. So he'll live in shortages. I learn to accept fullness as a blessing, As the Creator's care as inheritance. So it becomes a daily banner: Everything has its time and order.

587-7

Days burn, but the star burns too, Planets smolder around. Everything spins and flies somewhere, Where the Word commanded. I plan at random, supposedly, I fuss, stumble, find. Being won't be limited by me — I'll give birth to heirs after myself. Whatever the optimist and skeptic argue about, In sparks they didn't live in vain. They tangled in arithmetic formulas, But together served the Idea.

586-9

There are no sufferings, There are only sensations Inside one's own universe, Another's trouble is not trouble… I understand only some conversation, And that selectively, With overlays of experience. Without memory I wouldn't have even that… The mysterious Word Belongs to the Lord… So He wanted me to know Him Through pain, through joy, Attraction and alienation. He is reality to me, Though they consider it illusion.

585-7

They whisper around, especially reality: "He's the boss, and you're a fool." Youth is guilty, and now old age — Yesterday didn't work out and today isn't right. Disappointment shortens life, The wounded ego rebels, boils, But lesson after lesson invites to peace, In humiliations teaches wisdom: "My neighbor is better than me." Wife, boss and tsar, A beggar by the road, green snot… …Let love triumph. I'll accept. Let it work The gift of service.

584-1

Having agreed to the unattainable, The promised gnaws the core, Desperately pushes, hopelessly pulls And there's not enough time for the project. Loyalty to the idea won't sleep enough, won't eat enough, Love looks like anger And untruth serves truth — They praise the spy in betrayal. To serve one's own, He's inclined to deceive the enemy, Tears wool from strangers Even the lying politician… For the word is honor.

583-8

Problems surrounded, For I despised the commandments, I bother the mechanic, lawyer, doctor. A need arises for their protection — I drove the wrong way. I drink pills, fill papers, Spend money and nerves, I flee from the palace to caves, Fear and panic without break. And what if I return to the Life's Owner — Maybe He'll accept the prodigal son? I won't find a better adviser — People will pardon, Health will arrive, The machine will start.

582-8

Untested is not friendship. Yours are white, his are red, Sharp sabers, prancing horses — Service to different ideas. You chop left, slash right, Destroy everything in your path. But you'll kindly bypass your comrade, Lead trouble away from him. The chest shot through by him Carefully bandaged by him From our deep friendship Healed without scars.

581-8

A festival of old friendship And new acquaintances — An escape from civilization. The public one will feel a loner, The lonely will accept ovations. Throwing into the unusual, The hardened changes skin, The grand becomes modest, The spiritless gains faith. Freshness of emotions — Drank of freedom. Here it is, blessed peace. Congratulations! You're born again.

580-8

Heaven exists after all. How long shall hell mock? Peace comes someday. But is it really so far? A pleasant word to the neighbor, A memory of a happy dream Relieve the oppressive excess, Drive away darkness entirely. I carry hell and heaven in myself In dreams and awake. Weakness in health, strength in illness — I choose myself what I live in.

579-9

The universal is composed of trifles, A detail — galaxies of worlds. The small grew into the grand, Googles aren't bigger than zeros. Consciousness will outline itself with a frame, Feel the name, say: "I", However it caresses its own, It'll plunge into the abyss of oblivion. Disappear without a trace, To remember itself in other dimensions, And already new, completely unusual Will set to reincarnate.

578-8

Whether the bee gathers or gives — For the beekeeper's glory. Whether they kill the cowboy or he kills — The fatherland will record in archives. I rejoice or I weep — I live.
