I live or I die — to God. From nothing I came, to everything I go, To the Throne I see only the road. The Creator's project, Not I who planned About me, mine and around. We weren't, now we are, For He said, His commanding Word!

577-8

Drawings of sounds, alphabet systems — Business cards of peoples, their identity, Carriers of knowledge and problems of conflicts, Ossified through their habituation. The ancestors' heritage, Changed but not lost Is the history of reforms, In each letter — its own allegory. Humanity always lacked words, In them our strength and in them our weakness. Sounds alone are few. They are 25, combinations countless.

576-8

As soda fizzes and seethes from vinegar, Rhymes and meanings tore from the soul. Now the crater is empty, no growth, Where are those former verses? One must dig mines, Clay, ore and basalt, Without a crowbar, pick and shovel. Inspiration faded, alas. One could forget about it, Return to vanity, But, instead of the weekdays' poison, To the "lower" goal it pulls!

575-8

I ask advice to choose perfectly, I compare information. How to walk straight and not err, Not to step into a mess. More cards in hand — more chances To react to reality, Lo, sometimes even without finances Naivety wins. What I can, I do from my side, Such is my catching of happiness, Much depends on my step, Though loafers say: "Fate decides."

574-8

Yes, there is a problem. Should it really be avoided? Is it true that from one who bites and beats The only way is to flee quickly? From the bear, man, from the viper of fears? Demons laugh, hell's messengers. But remembering the power of words, Diplomat-rebels grow. They build dams, fly to space, Overcome separation from the neighbor, Tame evil and no longer tremble, To shake God's hand.

573-3

I'll agree with a deviation to the right, How else for the planet to go? We obey the authorities, but not slyly. In sound mind — forward! To the goal. So that having shifted the body's center, Not to swerve into the ditch, Not to stumble, not to fall, Not to break what you carried, To feel again That conscience survived, Not to lie, not to make A compromise with evil. No way without reforms, let's avoid stagnation, To overcome new obstacles Let's think together, you and I, To support the government, as a wise people.

572-1

I lived not so and not there — Conscience again judges the sinner. There's strength, no goal — The logistics broke. I insured myself, peace of soul I accepted in trust to God, He dictated verses to me And pointed the way. Happy and sad I return home. Not satisfied with myself? My fault: I doubted Him. (for Roksolana)

571-7

I flared up and burn, Though I could still smolder and smolder. I found myself on the rocky edge, Or maybe even fly? It seems I'm flying anyway, Having split into countless sparks, I'll rush over the world with an invisible nerve, Quietly, Without raising a whirlwind. Let them think: "Nothing happened. Think, he lived. But I live! — Everything around surrendered to me! One day I'll carry him as a spark!"

570-7

In my own hatred I won't bite my tail, Especially if I'm a reptile. The angered devours himself first, So it's laid in nature. That's why mostly the snake crawls past, Doesn't sting everyone who'd kill it (Wise, the bastard, knows it well)… I bypass enemies to live longer. Old but still going through school, I drink the poison of discontents as medicine, I keep polishing myself in a circle, I wear away, I help good.

569-8

To gorge on good at once — Is to grow a parasite in yourself. Better learn duties, To reach ecstasy in efforts. For the bee, having brought honey, For the queen, having kept the family, Victory is somewhere ahead, So I stay in the ranks. We're enveloped by the mystery of bliss: Amid constant anxieties Endure to madness — So God ordained. Don't count it a loss, Believe, hope and wait! And you'll receive payment after the finish, Heaven prepared with love.

568-9

The lover sees love in everything, Anxiety — only danger. The militant hasn't defeated all yet, The wanderer set out on a distant road. You're both a warrior, David, and tremble with fear, And a traveler — fleeing from Saul, You hate, you love, You shout And are silent, You weep in psalms, you sing. Not constantly and not simultaneously (Many don't get it here) Bitter and sweet water From one spring flows. The murky settles. Everything has its time and order.

567-9

An attentive ear will hear the word, A sharp mind will discern even the unspoken. The thinker holds a conversation with himself, So the imposed manifests in thoughts As good or trouble, Freedom or persecution. Responsible are not others, but you and I For blood or salvation For generations after us. "I'm nobody here, politicians are guilty," — We say for consolation. Cruel governors won't come to power If we don't agree, don't allow.

566-9

She visited and yesterday felt That I'm no longer interesting to her. Kisses and caresses, no, she didn't forget — But for fullness I'm not enough for her. A mistress with experience like no one, With raised chin, magnetized gaze Won't let go of her own, will tear from another's — Hurries after the next train. Don't try to detain her — The gypsy wind blows through the cells. Bless and don't take offense, Let the next one know bliss too. (Song of songs — to the Muse. The 564th also to her)

565-0

I never thought I'd call A divorced woman to me. And she has another suitor And her husband won't let go. Her father gathered us To his house for counsel, To peacefully solve the problem And wisely unite the family. The current one fusses — Too jealous, The other long ago in love. And I pity her — Let her choose herself. (The wife gave a three, I rate it ten myself, maybe someone won't begrudge even a four? :)

564-3

Half is not fullness. However the tightness presses, The cross is not even close in sight And there's still a bit of strength left. The mission isn't finished. While the heart beats and the chest breathes, The pilgrim's fate is doomed — People hope for him. And here is the gallows — An end to the last suffering. Already taken, as it turned out, The crown of thorns wasn't placed on me.

563-8

Indifference to another's grief Weaves a nest in the bushes by the house, The offended fate will lay eggs in it, Serpentine, to remember evil, To fear bites, to sleep with nightmares, Having lost the fellow villagers' trust. Left alone with punishments, Having fallen into the problem oneself. Aren't heartfelt peace and healthy relations Worth the main goal? Isn't it time to come to the thought: Maybe help after all?

562-9

For the chick to hatch, It must grow from the inside, And from outside embrace and warm it. It should first learn To fight problems. To teach others, First mature. The egg thinks it's wiser than the hen, The student than the professor, man than God, Understands better and sees wider, Recognizes only itself and no one else. Despite individualism And the cold of cosmos, However creation coddles itself, The soul's egoism is accepted, No other way was found for it — The Creator warms it too With the sun for eternity.

561-8

The personal drowns in statistics, Made of particles becomes people's, Compatriots are praised or trampled in criticism — I'm perceived as evil or kind. I'll confirm or deny, Change stereotypes, Rise with my chest or rush to flee — I'll show my country as truly mine. About us they read books, Heard the Kremlin's propaganda And finally recognized: Ukraine is me.

560-8

Gave — counted as returned to God. Sold — stole from Him. Bought — put to keep for Him. Accepted for free — owed. Stole — got rid of part of the soul, Took away — burned his own salvation, Defended the orphan — God praised, Offended — touched the apple of His eye. Armed with instructive experience In attained maturity Conscience and remorse will prompt How to reach eternity.

559-8

War is none of your business, Mr. missionary. Here the country is not yours and the trouble isn't yours, It's for us to die, and for you — beyond the shore. Easy to cheer to death, But to die yourself… You have your own understanding of honor. Go back home. "Thou shalt not kill!" — you tell son and dad, You bring humanitarian aid from across the sea, But for us to keep the commandment, We need people and weapons.

558-0

Marked cards and an ace up the sleeve Promise to win, Assistants are also one's own, To develop big stakes. Fraud and deception rule the world. The main thing is to bribe enemies, But that you yourself are bribed You must yourself Forget And to no one Tell. Ask the supreme about the pyramid's peak, On which he sat high, Whether his empire Will slide to hell When the Almighty's eye blinks?

557-8

Labyrinths of life With unknowns and dead ends Seem like freedom at the exit. But in fact a new discovery With mountains, forests and seas — A riddle in an even bigger form. The winner's feeling turns out to be weakness, The laurel leaves fall from the wreath, And paralyzed by the universe's grandeur You surrender to the Creator's mercy. I'm not an almighty god in my primitiveness. Don't bow before me, And I lack the favor Of Him who is in the heart and above the head.

556-9

A small hut with a stable — There seems no humbler place. Around are pretty girls, But She was born there. There She lived in embrace with trouble, Friendly to people, honored parents. Beloved, While we grew, I longed for you, Came to your home. They called me unhappy. But to the fellow villagers' surprise The worst became the best With the scent of lilac and roses.

555-6

If they accuse again You of harm done by someone, "From a sick head to a healthy one" — So they recognize among the people, Nobility and love for the neighbor, Readiness for self-humiliation — Not always incense for the Almighty. Abuses also need cleansing. You endured till now — reward awaits, But now you'll do wrong When you don't stop the cunning one — God will ask.

554-8

In the news they need sensations, They're silent about everyday events. The usual don't get ovations Neither grief nor grace. They started ignoring tragedy Their own, and even more another's, They want to read about changes — Not interested about the next widow. They say: "Normal, they bombed today too," But what's needed, like an elixir, Is to hear them announce About the long-forgotten Peace.

553-8

But not all is lost, not dying off. It's I, the old one, who gained years, And someone is just starting to live, Arrived on Earth yesterday. Sound and light amaze him, The taste of milk and the smell of bodies, The wide world beckons unusually, Many schools await. And I sifted, selected the best — An appendage for the born. In heaven it's easier, for them it's harder here. This is not the end — the beginning.

552-8

The sun in everything, strong in light, passes across the sky… They'll describe differently. And some joker will give birth to his own — Will discern in a circle or in the terrible flame. Walker, Everywhere-goer, Hell, Over-head… So words are formed, Shame in words, In words also glory. In dialects there are many of them and in languages: Borrowed from the ancients in the form of new ones. About relativity one should remember, It denies, it also approves: They await the rain, But flee from it too. With fire the sun warms, but hell burns.

551-8

The empire's lion grew hungry, Went out hunting. The prairie grew alarmed, About survival. The crocodile hoped To rescue the antelope, Or a herd of gorillas Would solve the problem. Justice froze, Ran to the storages, The crocodile with the lion Divide the prey.

550-9

The ego got lost among the stars, Or the stars swaddle it In the ovum, In the ant, in the human, In the caviar Planets fly Through cosmic spaces. They mix among themselves, Get ground up, Get affirmed as sifted flour, With the united I They gather In the mill called Earth. You're a grain And I'm a speck of dust, Each has their own needs. Personality is also our Little Hut: We are the Earth's Ego.

549-9

Anxiety rises like a crow flock, A pun of emotions, Threats on every side — With it I burn indifference. In shock, Panic and fuss The true support of friends Warns against false moves, Even if only in sympathy. Memory will inscribe with a chisel About the accumulation of suffering… … And then silence comes. Strangely, cleansing.

548-8

Every reality is a separate game. At the enterprise, in the country, in the anthill. A game of silence, or of words According to the role assigned to the participant. For the sculptor the toy is pliable clay, For the clown — poses and grimaces, For the manager — an obedient person, For the politician — the masses of people. A special art is to swap places, Voluntarily or under pressure, Peacefully or with battles — When the toy plays with its owner.

547-9

Vibrations of souls mixed chaotically, When suddenly a unison is felt, The startled heart beats unusually, Weekdays turn into a magical dream. The slumber fills with a fireworks of realities, You'll jump up, run in a pair, Grabbing bouquets of lilies of the valley, In dreams you'll soar above the clouds. You'll breathe with full chest With the session's meaning enriched. Now the main thing is that amplitude growth Doesn't lead to resonance.

546-9

I chased myself Through tangled labyrinths, But a straight road led to the finish. I broke through With heavy battles. No peace, sheer war. Someone will say: unwise. Here it is, the road. Why climb among bushes? For where people don't walk, Where their feet don't step, You'll gather many mushrooms. From A to B — an accessible goal. Easy to ride the beaten path, Glades and thickets in caring thoughts — This is the search for paradise through the hell of doubts.

545-9

From the unwise the wise will take wisdom, The wisest a fool will consider a fool. The contest between them is fruitless and sad, Until the wise pretends to be a pupil. Temporarily, to avoid quarrels, Spreading of ill fame, Instead gathering nectar From uncomfortable circumstances. For an invention, a higher idea Is on the edge of problem stoppage, Especially someone's nonsense Helps to become a model.

544-8

They come to destroy, but love them. The victim is also guilty. Enemies call themselves liberators, They give the defender the status of executioner. The world went mad, Traitor truth Was bought with silver. Noble anger Turned base. Suffering over the edge. Lost paradise Ever more illusory, However you care — Robbed to the thread.

543-9

For memory's sake they perform feats, Climb tribunes, paint pictures, The Chosen ones give birth to companions, Expand the country's borders. Hiding in the taiga and a pseudonym help To detach from the matrix, Returning to stone and stick, To end up alone. The turtle buries itself in silt To forget the world of sharks. To pray for sinful "geniuses", Remembering victims and draculas, The monk locks himself in a cell.

542-9

The firefighter is ready to rush At any time of day, Called to the fight, So grief doesn't happen. The calm city envies His salary for nothing, But suddenly hears the news: Someone's home caught fire. While they extinguish the fire, He'll save several lives. They'll carry the hero on their hands And forget in a few days.

541-8

No one pities the outsiders, Until you find yourself out yourself. It turns out nature Draws closed graphs. It lifts on the wave of success, To scoop up more stars... He doesn't lose his smile Who steps into the valley. Having accepted the law of gravity, He calmly crosses out days, Gives away shares for free, For a star waits at the bottom.

540-9

Whatever happens, waking in the morning, Lady panic won't make a scandal. Yesterday's continued in hourly labor Will calm tension, avoid failure. Nerves preserved, healthy emotions, Festive mood, balanced pressure. With inspiration, in new encouragement The diligent will show remarkable skill. We hear in the news, read in the paper — The planet lacks peace. It found itself in alarm... For someone can't overcome their own.

539-8

With its tip the arrow aimed at the sky, Hung in the clouds like a flying kite. It doesn't fall to earth, not disappointed, Guided by inspiration Of hopes And dreams. Where to get fuel? What's the idea? Life became interested — It flies home, To break through From the human shell, To reach the cosmic Ovum.

538-9

Philosophy seeks wisdom, Holy Scripture gives it. It adds confidence and calm courage To worship the Almighty, To serve the neighbor And value one's own. Sometimes comes what I don't ask for, What to do with it — I don't fully know. But I bring the most fruit, Having received what I await. No need to fear stumbling and falling. Much worse to stand in place. To betray neither God nor myself, I go to seek.

537-8

Our mother married again, The stepfather took to order, Took off his belt so we'd toil, And drove us to the beds. We understand life — We must work. We want and can, And our field is generous. The trouble is drunkards and robbers, Dad's friends. Like him, robbers, Despots in soul… We'll endure a bit more, Then we'll see. If he doesn't come to his senses, Preferably sooner, Mother will divorce, Or we'll rise.

536-7

The goalkeeper, the team's shield, Avoids the game and is ashamed, Stands motionless By the goalpost, While the ball rolls on its own. The stands will whistle, hoot — Enemies from joy, ours from shame. They force to replace the indifferent traitor, To leave the field spat upon. Foes will mock, friends will avoid. Thought he meant something — contempt instead. But amid all the tension around Conscience will judge the most.

535-7

The herd scattered, the savanna froze, A hungry predator hunts. The bewildered young The fatal queue passed by. Desperately fights The horned leader, Photographed by tourists. Onlookers seated in the cage-van And there's no one to shoot. Safaris became different, Gamekeepers no longer scare hyenas — Excursions smell of bigger profits. Demand satisfied, Spectators paid, Saw blood and thank.

534-8

The world hangs by a thread, It seems there's no God. Banknotes blind a person's eyes, Darkness creeps with deals. Soul is sold and conscience, Metastases in heads and in churches, Truth, you're losing consciousness, Mad on money. Come to your senses, get out of the shell, Let the sky see — you're still alive, Stop the insatiable ambitions of rashka. Show care, rise against evil!

533-9

The unsprinkled won't bear fruit. The sky will water with rain, Man — with blood and sweat. At first not at his own expense — He'll cut another's with the sword, And save his own. I'll sit on the throne, hide abroad, Aim the TCC at the neighbor, I'm proud of heroes at zero, I hold my fist for them. However I disguise myself, the moment comes: For the good of mine and enemies The ego lies in the ground. For their harvest I'll care maximally — I'll give all of myself.

532-8

A powerful order with many zeros The customer set up for me. Where to start, I have no idea. My capabilities are quite small. Competitors around push bribes, The tender seems already knocked out from under me, From all sides they set traps, Offering re-elections. The planet trembles with fear, Peels the leprosy's scab. The Lord promises He'll heal it. I am who I am, David of small stature.

531-9

With the help of Hebrew An explanation of the world. Thanks to Latin Order in medicine. Esperanto appeared, But didn't take root. In every village its own dialect, In the region — its own accent. Each century modifies the language, And the present offers its project. Mentioning Babylon — Returning home, To the first source. To mutual understanding, To the Creator — creation... No one's interested — To seek in vain. No paradise, no tower anymore.

530-8

A contract was made on Golgotha With red ink in a professional flourish. Valid to this day. About sinners' ransom — they are innocent. The last column for the slave — An empty space: Do you agree to go free? So we think, you and I, Afraid to fall for a trick. For among people it doesn't work so. Every fraud in his own eyes — The cunning master And seeks a fool. But here guarantees The cross and the nail… I guess I'll sign.

529-9

I spoke — they hated me. Had I been silent — they wouldn't have noticed. Had I thought correctly — everyone would be fine, Whether lying, sitting or running, They'd honor the frightened, praise the brave. They mock the senseless hero, A coward without cause deserves pity. Who can't listen isn't heard, They'll love me when I love myself. To filter oneself, to sift, To get rid of excess burden — No need to dream of more. Good is good thoughts.

528-8

They guard the nest, though the birds fly out, They tend, build, but time will take. They flee from the start for meaning, So that at the finish another's takes. Another's is the country, family and children. Genes are passed to them. So you don't leave the stage — You bind future with past, to live. Doubt as an inspector sometimes peeks in, Disturbs, conducts an audit, Puts thoughts in order And tunes again to the mission.

527-8

Divorces divide yesterday's unity, It didn't grow together. An unsuccessful attempt. Cohabitation threatening, even criminal, Love came to hate, though it seemed to love. Despair, loneliness. A broken trough. Fragments scattered, not even fragments left. You think: "Finish, my lived-out. A worthless mission, all in vain." You don't even suspect: the real is ahead. From a new sheet to a clean copy With gained experience already without gnashing, Without scandals, to which you almost got used.

526-7

Worms will start even in clouds, (iCloud) From thieves below you can't hide even here. They're inventive in ruling through quarrels — From theirs you can't free yourself even in heaven. You strive to hide in freedom from untruth, You change passwords, registration, Until they force you to surrender in pursuits From the pressure of enslavement. The bandit won't fall behind, The torment won't stop Without sheep's fangs, without a hare's hooves, Without a shield, without a sword and without a bow.

525-9

I painted, finished, liked it. On the canvas called one's own life. Layer on layer had to be applied With different subjects to paints. Stretched on a single frame, They didn't give another. To strive for perfection Oil and paints call. Imagination and your memory are the artist's. Life is a calling-search-bridge. The last stroke will show Your quality as a God-pleaser.

524-9

Today I haven't written a verse yet, So maybe I'll write now. Yesterday I got tired, so I slept soundly, In a moment I'll wake and stir thoughts. I'll reveal the main one and grab onto it, Hold it by the hand till night, Won't tire of its advice, Take knowledge and vigor. So as not to run headlong at random, To get benefit from its hints — Here I found a thought: Vigor.

523-8

Silence kills and the word sins, Thought controls both. Whether late or hasty — Don't expect a gift from fate. Between zero and boundlessness the sky's firmament, Ropes stretched in it. To overcome maiming and death, One must balance. Help me grab the insurance, To recognize the rescuing word, To learn not to err, To step on a reliable foundation.

522-8

The agitated world demands truth. Everyone goes to it with lies. I'd tear corrupt officials apart, Consider impeccable Only myself. Being in the center, and hyenas around, With what chalk to fence off from them? Of Buddhas, Christs, Avicennas, To make predators happy and not become a victim? Without cunning you can't do With lack of wisdom and holiness. Maybe we'll reach truth someday, But for now we perfect nastiness.

521-8

The samurai's path is to uphold honor In loyalty to the lord with truth's coat of arms, Not to doubt at the crossroads, With a sword in different directions, With an unaverted brow. Constant resolve to nip evil, To feel with the back, to be vigilant in sleep, Not to sell out and to love nobly — Of these threads are woven years and days. To manage to resist The meanness of betrayal. Not to die shamefully, But to truly live, Even after death not to drop the weapon, Not to release from cooled hands.

520-8

Unhappy is my fate. Of my parents, son and grandson. Mine is not my land, With my own I am parted. For all I am a stranger, I'm not kin even to myself. So spineless — That's why poor. The Synod decides for me, A pack sick with ruling. Am I not the people? Enough hiding in holes!

519-8

She sucked out and left. I'm not the first, nor the last. We wither so she blooms In the cruel contest for laurels. Poetry's beauty is in our exhaustion, In sleepless nights of searching words. All other cares forgotten and abandoned, We don't notice the passage of days. You're worthy to be bowed to. You're holy, and our soul is sinful. You know everything, to learn from you. We dry up, that's why you're eternal.

518-8

The best warming point is at home. But what if there's no warmth at home? And you're needed by no one, In autumn and spring, and in summer it's winter. Brought firewood into the house, but it won't burn. They'll say: "Such a host he is. And let him not bother our heads — An unhappy man and we pity him." But he'll find a lonely one across the ocean, At the edge of the earth, hard to believe. Quite by chance, with no plan — And both will warm up.

517-9

There'll remain a remnant lucky To taste victory. And one that'll know defeat's crucible, Hiding the need to return losses. Better for him who dies first, Doesn't weep for his own and doesn't strangle others', He's the crafty one — he rests, Among the living doesn't multiply sin. Good is relative, it's in the chest, Where the soul lives In pious people, Or where it has gone.

516-9

We left peace, to peace we go Through tension between poles, To learn to avoid problems According to the Creator's program. Situation is a challenge. It freezes — it burns. Safety is urgently needed. Hard to hide, the threat grows, From everywhere non-safety threatens. Without non-safety you can't do, It stimulates life, Not without non-safety they fought once, Not without non-heavens non-safety lurks. (A joke on the nonexistent word Peka)

515-8

You attack the weaker, On strangers and on ours? Three endure, but the fifth will rise. You'll hit resistance — then don't cry. You'll have to pay for inflicted wounds — Money won't suffice, however rich you are. If I praise, they'll praise me too. If I humiliate — they'll humiliate me. Justice has a long memory, Reward and punishment won't pass by. They'll bury the great in the mausoleum wall, Push the innocent into Babyn Yar? The recorded cries of victims and executioners — Death won't hide, Justice awaits, Sooner or later it'll resolve the nightmare.

514-8

Gifts are brought for two reasons: Gratitude or a bribe. In all peoples and in all countries The gift asks and thanks. The grateful thank, the grabbers ask, They thank the kind, flatter the evil. A gift will please, relieve tension, The hard and cruel will become soft. Who gives to others, but doesn't accept himself, Having helped with good, goes for the next, He gains honor among people and God, Puts a deposit on the heavenly account.

513-8

Gathered stones — Time to scatter. So justice commands. Enough chasing fate and fleeing from it — Here's the ideal opportunity: To surrender to it, to catch it. The circle closed — the mission completed, Having started from zero, reached zero… But life's mystery doesn't decide so: At the start the Twelve was with you, At the finish it's yours too. Want to grieve, want to be proud, Calling the moment of the Spark immortality. Agree or argue: You're clay for eternity, and it's the instrument.

512-9

Nightly sleeplessness — Is prayer, Grinding, rubbing, Diminishing oneself. A chase for clarity. But when ignored, The teacher goes away. Anxiety, stress, the kidneys worked, The liver calls to the toilet. The hand hasn't even touched four — The poet suffers in prayer. Above him works the Word of the day, Gives a sword, shield and helmet. Hands strength for life, To carry dignity, not shame.

511-8

Shards of feelings, Fragments of the experienced Will compose any pattern — With lips And hands Of masters Or frauds. From the familiar and habitual — A masterpiece or a botch. An anecdote and truth, A dry hint and a melodious song Carry yesterday's taken into tomorrow — It served before, it'll serve after. You think — unseen? You say, haven't heard yet? The found is once the lost, The future is the resurrected past.

510-8

Banknotes attract, promise good, Orient toward a profession's choice. For life in New York or Chicago, If not in Germany, then at least in Greece. The call for money somehow doesn't care. And vice versa, leaves with a bag — An artist in rags cares for spirituality, Neglects the bodily, but with proud posture. And duties press, and you tear to freedom, To rule, to serve — two goals. Like a fish from under ice for air, you struggle To care for the body and save the soul.

509-9

Quiet… It's coming… Don't scare. Not a rustle. Barely breathe. You waited long. And wait more, Don't hurry, listen, expect. No steps heard yet, no words, no whisper, Only a thought-feather touched — Don't bring at once to a gnash, So as not to alarm, so it doesn't deflate. Let there be noise in the yard And the retinue ready to depart — A conversation in the Holy of Holies Calibrates the intention correctly.

508-9

You came in wreaths, in royal robes — To me, to a commoner (Think, in pants), You poured fragrant myrrh into vessels. Who am I for Your caresses? … The noble aren't always pleasant to You — So I love You without jealousy, And to please You is a zealous desire. Tender princess, Don't let me be shamed. Teach to the level To be filled with honor. (To the Wisdom of Poetry)

507-9

I float as a cloud in verses, Sometimes in better, sometimes in worse — Don't seek me in relics. And who needs me more On crowded squares? Imperceptibly I'll shield from the sun With shelter over heads. Don't be proud of me and don't be ashamed — For you I'm absent, actually I'm with you. Let it scorch from above — I expose myself to the luminary gladly, Behind me others gather in line With shadow, rains, snows or hail.

506-9

In old age he hid a stash. Especially from his wife, children and grandchildren. So they wouldn't track — he had a task: He peered at shadows, listened to sounds. He initiated the most honest outsider About the place shortly before death, Asked to tell the widow about it After he was to die. Without warning, he re-hid. Reliably, no one will find. Unexpectedly gave his soul to God. No treasure — who didn't even search. He outwitted everyone, even himself.

505-8

Tomorrow I'll become funny, Backward and primitive, Dreams will lead me to a dead end. I hope they won't consider me too guilty, For I long unlearned to justify myself. To admit weakness in declining age, To find peace in old age's harbor, As in a mirror, to drown in grandchildren's bloom — It's worth reaching such a comma. To a comma. For the path continues, Ahead a new start. The future awaits the experience of the lived, A gift of practice to a student with a diploma.

504-6

I live to take, leaving a trace... …Traces are swept and washed away. Raised to clouds it falls with rain, To, having returned, perfect the world. Left — they took. Equipment, remains and memory. They dragged apart And didn't remember Where they even buried. What was grabbed I'll give to the office, There they'll assess, send the gains back. A record about the soul, healthy Or sick, They'll enter into the Book of Life.

503-8

To another attempt to save the language The reaction — Russian doesn't bother us, Ukrainian loyalty again and again Steps on the same rake. Having heard "don't understand" from afar, Suddenly the tongue betrays, Right away I forget my native, I'm more used to the foreign. Children grow, and behind them grandchildren. Let's be ready, so we're not surprised, If soon we'll have to hear "We are Russians, for our parents Spoke Russian."

502-9

I look at the mountains, Someone's interested in the forest, Someone talks about war, Someone's nose is stuffed. Everyone has their problems And everyone has their own ache. So on different topics It boils in our thoughts. You'll best tell about your own, Another's soul is fog. You advise yourself in verses, And let everyone seek within themselves.

501-7

The flame of his embraces is insatiable, The doomed burn in it to ashes, Friends will leave, their curiosity will vanish, For you weren't a victim for them. The word beckoned you, You stretched with sparks to the clouds, But even as smoke you floated not long And the heat warmed no one. Everyone doesn't care, each has their own trouble, Your return is needed by no one, But suddenly you'll realize another demand: You left the house — the whole street is yours. (The Word and the Soul)

500-9

If the Throne is a logical reality, Not a religious invention, They'll consider the activity noble, Not the tricks of a degenerate. Not for a stranger's eye, Not for earthly glory Is morality high, So they lie with it. The absence of truth in the world — Is a quiver for an arrow That will reach the goal As the hunter directs.

499-8

Key-words To the heart, money, flights Lead out of various bindings. With passwords — one's own, Without them — strangers. Knowledge is words. The initiated in them passes. No knowledge, Then no success either. Who ignores them harms himself. Hard to carry in the head — A computer, phone, paper Will help remember. Passwords and key-words Must be kept.

498-9

Habit binds to the deed, Constant and strong gives result, Points to the owner's character, Becomes the cause of tragedies and holidays. Good brings glory, Bad — mockery and shame, With the first it's interesting to live, The second leads to trouble. Do they choose it, or does it find? Who's guilty, who deserves praise? Fate decides, the laws of nature. Human or habit — that's their scale.

497-9

A series is more interesting than one's own life, Evening screens finally flare up, The day's events — Unneeded trash, Others' fantasies — a source of mood. Don't be ashamed, for you're not a parasite, And let conscience not judge for the parallel: The world is composed of overlays of realities, And before you people lived the same. They read books, wrote works, Told stories, gossiped, Don't worry, you're not sick either, They just didn't have the internet then.

496-9

Mother Earth, you'll embrace and kiss, You'll take the child into the womb again, When you teach and prepare The Father's soul for eternal heavens. And while inseparable from the body It rejoices or is sad, Lives at full voice or silently — Peace and war shape it. It meets like-minded friends, Spits and poison of enemies, To perfect itself in thought — So Dad wanted.

495-9

From a deep well the water is healing, On the surface used — unless filtered. The subconscious's hint is undying, A surface thought is uncalibrated. Intuition is ancestors' experience Gathered in treasuries, Golden dust from volumes of notes, Given to descendants by neutrons. Winnowing and cleansing Of wagons of thought ore — Is calibration and raising the assay For next generations of neutrons.

494-8

The newborn enters greater glory, Previous worlds say goodbye to him, They entrust him with a grander deed — Not to stumble on abortion, but to grow further. The lower pushes, the upper awaits, Now sprouts, tomorrow fruits. Which? Consciousness decides, The level of truth it managed to reach. Truth lies in striving, At each stage it renews the banner. Pleasure is in the process, not in achievement, So I don't regret that I didn't achieve.

493-9

Adam lay down with the question "why?" In full abundance along eternity, And suddenly it became cramped in boundlessness From lack of need to change reality. A rusted wagon stood in a dead end, Thought: "Here I'll stay for good." Unexpectedly the wheels screeched — A locomotive pulled along the track. They took a rib, Eve appeared, And with her Ideas, Cargoes and routes For home and for the womb — About blues and peace you'll have to forget.

492-9

Critics aren't loved, they're avoided, But better teachers can't be found. The benevolent also teach, But don't spur as much To go faster. If you don't overcome the distance, you'll learn resistance. One way or another, thank the enemy. No need to fear the prickly reproach, Having grown kinder from evil, repel evil too. When the enemy comes to kill, Gather in yourself the wisdom to stand as a breast, So taught by him you find what to say, Save village and city from trouble.

491-8

At the tunnel's end new horizons For idea, thought, word and deeds. In discomfort through the hole of a tight passage You emerge into a space you didn't know. Before the forehead a wall threatens collapse, They already carry to the cemetery, remove from earth — An invisible capsule of the soul's immortality flies Through the tunnel with immeasurable sweep. This journey excites and is full of doubts, Frightens with the fear of death without measure. No wonder — for the fullness is inexpressible, Bliss and ecstasy in the presence of faith.

490-8

On joined wires they put a tube, Turned left, fused the contact, Perfected another little soul But something went wrong again. Society was replenished with another moron, Morons released a moron from the laboratory, Already persuaded the next victim And instead of growing again emasculated. In a group with morons I'm a moron myself I stroll along the coast — Among healthy souls, unmaimed bodies With morons in white coats, I greet like kin. (Propaganda)

489-8

Real roads are paved with mirages, Dreams call to enliven the universe. At first glance there's lack of opportunity, And suddenly — civilization at a crossroads. Haven't thought yet, but someone already did, Imagination also competes. Others walked where you didn't, The bio-anthill seethes and boils. Someone was trampled, someone tramples himself, What the fuss is about, they didn't say to the end. Road to new mirages! For the affirmation of full Glory.

488-9

Trap. Betrayed. After long years of fidelity. She doesn't know yet — I've already lost her… Didn't expect such meanness from myself. Fog enveloped consciousness, A random beauty attracted, Deception can't be covered with any words, And without my betrothed I can't live. Indifferent to the whole world, Only she alone Cares for me. Oh, how the heart tears and aches — My beloved wife will lose her soul If she gets disappointed in me.

487-8

Dreams swapped with reality, I want to fall asleep instead of waking up. In dreams I get drunk with joy, To plunge again into days of anxieties. I'd rather call dreams life, Daytime nightmares — the fog of sleep, They said to live means to suffer, But I, when I sleep, truly live. They put cables on the wrong terminals, Reality and dreams got mixed up. Hands of war, you messed something up, Put back my poles.

486-7

While cans were filled with milk, The needy took and said That you're good. But suddenly you stopped giving milk. You were supposed to bring Big money. Not fully ready, it turned out. Shame on the cow! Yesterday's best become the worst — To the market or for meat! They scheme to replace them with others — The appetites of the greedy sometimes go off scale. No claims to the indifferent, In vain to expect handouts from them, Even murderers are forgiven in a sense — Who used to give And stopped, Is guilty. (The wife said: "That's life.")

485-8

Friendship cracks, Suspicion paints pictures for offenses. From self-pity the soul aches — It looks outward, seeks causes. At hand the closest, who shared bread, Not so floury as hearty — Why was he silent or said the wrong thing? Who's guilty? He's first. The satisfied enemy, sympathizing, will listen, Rejoice — the opponent weakened. Later a comrade will extricate from the web, And a saddened slave will come out to freedom.

484-8

He who cares for us from time immemorial, Hands to parents and gives teachers, Whose love is without bounds and without count, Wanted to grow the great from zero. Called from nothing, taught to speak, From cradle and school gathered into society, Through death leads to truly live, So he who killed Has no right anymore. Waters and feeds at lower levels, Uses circumstances as mediators. Calls home no longer by families, But into a family of descendants and predecessors.

483-9

They love for beauty, attention, tenderness, Paper brought you and me together. Then came care and fidelity, But first was a test and a written essay. A beautiful soul hid its gaze, Was ashamed of words, was silent. Not by chance we ended up side by side — I read your soul on the sheet. Don't look my way, don't say anything, I know you're mine, between us a magnet. Neither you nor I need anyone, The world is filled only with you and me.

482-9

Live a century, learn a century. Persistently take from the surroundings. Someday knowledge will accumulate With the necessity of proclaiming it. And let it be needed by no one, Said by the author to himself It'll go out and return home With more perfect phrases. It'll accept from the experience of its teachers, Thank wise words, So finally it understands itself: The best adviser for it is itself.

481-7

Ukraine has been trampled for centuries, They exterminate the kin, But it, like a seed field with cucumbers, Fills the world. They grab it into captivity, It saves itself as a fugitive, Under occupiers got used to pain, Defends independence with shield and sword. And now the persecuted is accepted By Argentina, Canada and Taiwan. Russians take into captivity, And mercilessly kill it, Budapest reddens from its promises.

480-8

Why would a miner buy coal — He brings it home in his pockets. Does a host go to someone else's wedding When he invites guests to himself? There's demand for goods — it sells, A kopeck pays for it, They pour into a carafe, for it won't spill, If, of course, it's not a funnel. The trembita blows sound To drive away silence, The reader doesn't write — reads, So I have something to read — I write.

479-8

Yesterday these verses didn't exist, Tomorrow — they're trash. Only what conscience felt today, That's what's called real life. Plans for the future and regret for the past Rob the present. Have a square — don't grieve for the round, No sack, a handful will feed. Right now your gratitude decides: Whether you hold the track or flew off the slope, What brakes, and what accelerates, Gives abundance or brings to tears.

478-9

The word goes beyond meaning, It seeks another, A new one Or the one That is lost, In a team — a greater sense. From nothing it embraces everything. The ether is still too empty, It brings unusual concepts Into the idea of comfort in anxiety. It strives for perfection, tears through thickets, Spurred from behind, advances forcedly. It'll have to lie under evolution's roller — So it is determined.

477-8

Poets are like snow in winter. On each a dossier about himself. Each uses the word as a weapon — It either praises or painfully hits. It troubled the author, so he wrote, The reader doesn't care, but for him — a volcano: From the depths of the subconscious he learned, found out How to achieve, avoiding wounds. Whether they'll praise or curse — For the thinker the meaning is not in that, But in whether he managed to become human, Whether he matured, having returned to the eternal home.

476-8

One day after rain In the middle of the melon field Unexpectedly It cracked loudly. Ripe, Dark red, Juicy. Kherson one. Striped brothers idled nearby. On another field a farmer gathered hops. Brothers and sisters wondered under burdock leaves — There wasn't even a thief with a knife. The watermelon proclaimed Glory to Life!

475-9

A mirror is meant to examine oneself And watch the surroundings. It tears pieces of sun for someone, Scares someone, and for someone — encouragement. Mirrors around conduct a conversation, But the most important is mounted inside. They look into it again and again, Scan their own, hidden from others. They cut paths — Mirrors in eyes, Seek differences In friends and enemies.

474-7

The muse doesn't hear the indifferent, Doesn't touch the callous, Doesn't disturb the anxious, Smoothly passes the egoist. The relaxed won't ring, Have no thoughts, so won't speak, The self-confident will stumble, The too taut will tear, The hasty will be thrown out early. Inspiration is extremely sensitive, And it touches the one Who in grief recognizes the happy — For such life will play in major.

473-9

To pity the tree, or envy it? Who of us is better, who worse? Like me, it doesn't walk to climb on me, But taller than me and greater in mass. I travel the world and am everywhere, Saturate my eyes, move my body, Mostly absent, I leave home, But it's faithful to its place, stuck to the earth. I'll stop too, they'll put me in a box, But it'll be sawn, cut into parts — For people to seek their stop, But trees will keep theirs.

472-7

Lived actively, gathered an inheritance. As a result — to carry to trash. Mocked, jeered at the elders, Couldn't take to the grave with him, Like they couldn't — The high threshold of death prevented. Why does the instinct to hoard call? The surface is indifferent to the buried. The Sun writes with patterns on darkness, On female beginnings with male beginnings. Life emerges, The frozen cracks and melts. It soars to clouds again for merging — The illuminated form is glorified by changes.

471-8

A year of cooperation with poetry passes, It asks to summarize. I combined it with family, with profession, To open eyes wider to the world. Above all — for myself, Asking heaven. It sees me distinctly. I don't want to walk in darkness, I need to help my own soul, Not to teach my neighbor sarcastically. Thank you, Teacher, for the treasures. On this Christmas day especially. Lead so wonderfully further. Your Love is above the wonders of wonders.

470-8

Imagination stuffed with "cotton" won't explode — You can't chop a log with a feather Even with an eager attempt: They realize the way to achieve the goal. A reaction to an irritant, Coordinated behavior — What the participant, Such the assessment. To gain the great, Seemingly even senseless, It's useful to know: If the right one, A quiet word Is enough to say.

469-7

To put freedom on bayonets — That's how empires arise. Not to succumb to them, Not to fall into dependence, To drive away others' wolves — Intercontinental artillery is not enough. One needs the fear of the Lord. The most powerful evil ruler, An enemy to people and God — A worthless master, His gains are dust. He'll conquer half the world, Turn into ruin, Call all curses upon himself, Enter history undoubtedly — About his own shame And his country's cruelty He'll write in blood into the century.

468-9

Honey is sweet but sticky, The bee stings, but is surrounded by love. A match is relatively light, But heavy is the ruin gutted by fire. A word is just a sound, An air wave. No hands needed — It'll do so much. It'll lead to partings Or speak so kindly That it'll relieve душевні муки. Only the throat will creak — from nothing It'll revive strength, Console the sad, Cheer the weak. Sweet, sticky, biting, healing, Light and heavy always with you. Paralyzing or mighty It capitulates or calls to battle.

467-9

Sin is to constantly remind of problems, Sin is to forget them entirely, Sin is to flee, abandon and betray, Sin is to stay, not hearing warnings. Sin is to wait in a hopeless place, Sin is to rush headlong into flame, Sin is desertion in haste, Sin is to burn on the spot. Sin in everything, but where is holiness?… … To remind and to forget, To hold and to abandon. Lucky to orient, To listen or ignore. May childhood guess, may old age not stumble — To hide or run out, To despair or hope. To know confidently When to drown and where to burn — Not to err among heaven's stands.

466-8

Advisers are needed by everyone Who makes important decisions In peaceful conditions or in anxious time — For one's own improvement, for enemies' worsening. I am a ruler too, though I have no servants — I govern the body, serve the soul. Left or right — I don't know at once, Others' thoughts help. "You are experienced, teach the unwise," — I'll ask the horsemen, Inquire of the pedestrians, Listen to the truly wise, Not driving away even the worse from him.

465-9

Drink a friend. You're not a vampire — He's pleased to give himself to you. But remember, only till then While he wants to play with you, While he's interesting to you too. So coercion doesn't quarrel you, So cunning calculation doesn't creep in, Heated by someone. Company is God's gift, A sunny glade in a dark forest, A gap among solid clouds — In a certain period and in a certain place.

464-8

Who is Abel? A legend? Inventions? A myth? Survived — means Cain, Killed the weaker — won! Pyramids, tombs and mausoleums. To the murderer — glory, compliments and honors, To gain a crown, to go wild because of it — For the world — a sign of valor. But triumph is for the victims, For those who didn't steal, Didn't take away, But paid. Stopped the frenzied With love, Who rose from the dead And came alive for the Kingdom.

463-8

The mob needs leaders, To fear the system — On land, in sky and on water Not to fight off oligarchs' hands. A proud gait, glassy eyes — The supreme's body language betrays: Got success, victory — not yet. Thinks about next victims, weighs. For bigger extortions — laws and a stick: They'll give the state and scepter to the chosen. But when a ruler fights for truth — Boyars will throw such from the throne.

462-9

Yesterday's brothers and seeming friends Didn't divide, quarreled — War flared between them. Don't say it's far, For hatred rolled Not only through the district — Passed like a plow through Americas and Europes. The key to love still not found, Though it seemed held in hands. Each separately craves greatness, We display holiness, but drown in sins. The sting of revenge is so tireless, And conscience calls to the peak of salvation, To finally achieve understanding, Where not primacy, but modest neighborhood, And mutual blessing.

461-8

Through the tunnel of death to the other side of the mountain — Such landscapes await there! Many talked about them, But didn't see themselves — nothing but plantings. They fantasized, Only guessed, imagined. I'll check myself And finally find out. I'd tell you too, But have no opportunity. They decreed from outside To achieve fullness by faith. The path is one-way. They ordered not to lay the return.

460-9

There is an order, a primordial pattern. Regardless, builds or breaks the law, Consequence and cause Cannot be swapped. Society forms a person, And under God it is, even godless. It stretches to heaven to rule the world, Over the earth, like a true owner. Were children born before parents? Isn't first the fire, and then the extinguisher? The poet wanted to say, So everyone applauds right away. As if a mosquito blew on the planet, And it spun around its axis.

459-7

The old plucks its own feathers, To insulate and strengthen the nest, Changes the Name for a pseudonym, Gives itself away so the birds live. Just imagine lipstick on the beak, Polished claws, painted forelock — Neatness is pleasant among people, But behind remained maidenhood and marriage. Self-preservation affirmed itself, Gathered many years, Laid eggs, bore children, And now must continue the kin.

458-8

Each separately is a note for cacophony. Together — a grandiose orchestra. The mosquito doesn't hear the whole symphony, Has no idea of the full register. Considers its squeaking aimless And doesn't suspect the great gift — At the cost of life with joint effort It'll cause… a clap of palms… Listen… Around and inside is music: Mountains, a grain of sand, elephants. Thunder amid the sky, buttoning a button, The creak of a feather and the whisper of war.

457-8

For the grateful dreams already come true, He opened the gates hospitably for them. The greedy chases happiness — But it flees, though it seemed caught. It trusted — not what was grabbed. A successful fate has a sensitive soul. It always wanted to join the good — Without a whip, without the bait of a penny. A cage, even spacious, Will someday empty, for the prey will flee. The grateful's granary is filled to the brim. And will be filled more.

456-8

They turn away from the famous. He's friends with glory, and who am I? Stars gather around him, They carry him in their arms. But for some reason he's sad! A crowd surrounds, ovations don't cease, They push and envy, but around are strangers. Even having become the nation's property, There's no soul to press to the chest. Everyone is attracted by greatness Without it they're sorrowful. But experience reminds: Idols are very lonely.

455-8

Placed on the edge for left and right, Long became the center between them. With the appetites of cunning neighbors It dreamed of independence. Sometimes even had it. For a short time. While the hordes, tired, Driven away and shamed, Gathered strength, Repaired plows and broken swords And secretly made revenge plans. Revived empires didn't spare people, Stirred the fires of propaganda, Harnessed iron horses again And plowed borders once more.

454-8

In uncontrolled jealousies Crocodile teeth and a wide throat. Why hurry to fall into them? Isn't it better in calmed emotions To stand proudly — To save someone and save yourself. With straight posture, with raised face, With an apt word and a clean gaze. Not to surrender yourself and to those bent by fate To help With personal example. Paralyzed by feelings In love, in finance, at work, Having surrounded yourself with healthy thoughts, To point the soul and flesh to the exit.

453-7

Don't combine dried fish with meat cutlets, Don't wash down wine with milk. Incompatible dishes aren't just with etiquette, They won't be accepted by the stomach itself. Some combinations ask to be divided, Water can't be mixed with fire. Wheels won't roll uphill by themselves. They're turned by a motor or pulled by a horse. The nature of motors and horses is different, Like the landmarks of callings. Let's recognize at the start, before it's too late: Not always does two plus two make four.

452-8

The imagined strikes sparks, The imagined extinguishes fires. The imagined crushes boundaries, The imagined wants to sit down. The imagined weeps, The imagined smiles. The imagined offends, The imagined is offended. What to imagine, I must choose: What to caress, And what to drive out of myself.

451-7

The famous song of "good" Russians: "Don't take us for the bad ones. It's the unworthy government, not us. It ordered us, Gave rubles — So we kill And die ourselves. It set us on you, But we Don't want war. We'll rise from our knees, the government will change, We'll live anew — we'll make peace. They'll respect us, Speak Russian, Russia will expand, We'll embrace again. You'll see how good we are. On your ruins, in your rear. But now It's not our fault, But money's. Don't judge us, ask Moscow."

450-8

Where does the idea come from? Yesterday I prepared soil for it. Today my field is for sale, The invisible farmer knew what he bought. Fertile for sport, science or singing, War or love, money or trouble — I'll climb the mountain or fall into the abyss — My new master will sow thoughts. The grain will sprout. I'll weed or tear out — Depends on me and neighboring masters. I'll root into the peak or plunge into the crater — In the will of micro- and macroworlds.

449-8

QR, strokes, words, programs, Protrusions, hollows, ones, zeros, To converge in tastes, To coincide in thoughts. To appear, disappear from the earth's surface. To make someone happy with one's presence, Not to become an obstacle on the highway, To pour a pile of claims on the scoundrel, To mount a horse, and it'll carry. Crawl up and jump away, Run and come. Release and support — Just coordinate with the code.

448-8

"Wasser" falls from the sky, From "aqua" and "aqua" the world is created. "Voda" and "hydro" rules and governs, "Water" swirls, Like the word "hello". "Pani" fastens, "Rano" runs, "Ura" composes, "Vero" seethes. We drink it, We water with it. Everywhere with it, wherever we go. Without it we have nothing — We live by it.

447-7

Where you took, You'll have to return there. Where you invested, From there you'll take. Not always at once — sometimes long to wait, But you won't bypass justice. Sowed good — It'll float with bread, Misfortune on the head — for former evil. Disrespect for father and mother Will turn descendants into a snake's nest. Boomerang and karma — Foreign words, But cause and effect are easy to understand. Tomorrow the current poor will get rich. After winter come, stork.

446-8

The good and evil On the face of the Earth, Around the Sun and in the orbits of Galaxies In different scales of different glory Accomplish grandiose and tiny deeds, Where the MegaUniverse is a worthless scrap. Where a bacterium doesn't imagine The stadium's limits. Hates, loves, Hurries home. Where atoms with electrons Have their own measures of time — By their laws I enter the class, To understand the surroundings and the middle, In harmony with them to serve the Plan.

445-8

That leech will yet drink blood. It quieted, didn't flee to Russia. The slowed mine will yet do its thing — The loyal till now will yet regret. The collaborator changed shoes, became a patriot, She's in the vanguard for independence. At the first opportunity she recalled the imperial. In the end — for now caution. The fifth column waits in the underground. It's among us. The aggressor cares for it, For he used and uses more than once.

444-9

Despite clouds the sun above them, Light and warmth over obstacles, Below a person's character forms, A people obedient to truth or буйний. Some will understand that twilight is good, Others will drive darkness away entirely. But best to find balance — Both sun and clouds bring benefit. To water with rain, To reap in drought. Not to fear changes. If only to know Where to expose yourself And where to hide.

443-7

Breathed in and out — but where is life? It's felt only at joints. As a result of efforts small or great Memory is preserved, all the rest is trash. Built And it fell, Drove, ate through. Had What I wanted, And it's gone. At the end said: "I was born with nothing, With nothing I depart. Like the WORD, like smoke. Dissolved by it In the archives of BEING I WILL be able to dissolve." (Dedicated to Bohdan Smolyak. To the wisdom of his observations)

442-9

It pulls to forget, to jump to paradise. Here's the powder — sniff and rejoice. I leave the body for a while, Take me, for I'm no longer my own. And truly they hurry to use the soul, Satan loves it differently than God: To the disfigured he allows to return Into a dishonored body full of anxieties. For the goods of temptations one must pay: I abandon duties — I steal from heaven. Spirit-guided to serve the body, As I tried — I'll report.

441-8

An unattainable star… The shepherd and the tsar On the peak and throne Are enveloped by unrest — Primitive desires turn immodest, Steps jump over the horizon. The present doesn't satisfy. We call artificial intelligence for help, Listening to the Primordial Insures, To bring wonders to the status of the usual. Despite all errors As a symbol of eternity The three tries To become an eight. It puffs up, The kopeck dreams of growing into a hryvnia. The finger stretches to God's finger, To merge with the Creator one like the Creator.

440-9

Let's forget about it. How long can it go? Three years of war! Let's return to the peace we so long for, For it's going toward spring, Not toward winter. Why depress And bore others? Let's sing And dance, Not notice grief, Pay no attention to pain and trouble. I sing, dance, Walk bars, Have fun, joke, For I am an optimist. But from the tired I meet only condemnation. For indifference — hatred, malice and anger.

439-6

Emotions someday burn out — Sharp needs gradually fade, Jumps for happiness aren't so high, They get used to sufferings, They're not so deep anymore. Old age, indifference, the time of philosophies, Generalizations and sorting, Feeling oneself nailed on Golgotha And just curiosity, awaiting eternity. They laughed at it, ignored it, Fanatically believed in it, Never truly imagined it, Dared, finally, to know. For Your personal pointing Only at her — thank you. Thank you! For love, so pure, Thank you. And thank you again. I'm not a hero, for she went for me, And not because I found. These are Your wondrous deeds, This is Your fatherly Love.

357-9

Not man dictated laws to Him By which to live. Ignored them and didn't accept — So will be beaten.

356-9

355-9

354-3

353-9

Victories, Trophies and awards — Are the humiliation of the weak.

352-9

Will they despise, or keep in the heart? I'll notice, call, Embrace and write down. Both slogan and parable I'll leave to descendants.

351-9

350-6

349-9

They sympathize around, Pity and cry, Though Faith is available to everyone, That in the new world they'll see you — Not in the hell of suffering, but in God's comfort.

348-9

Lightly touching The villi of words, Jokingly or seriously, Unconsciously or virtuosically They rudely intrude Into the fates of worlds.

347-9

For a separate person and the whole nation Only love for us all — A signpost from death For the exit to freedom.

346-9

The slain Abel Will be subjected to oblivion, Cain will be proclaimed a saint.

345-9

Through a small mistake They understood wrongly, A punctuation mark Made a pause.

344-8

Seven days gathered, Time to rest, The weekend came — The week ended… Look at the moon. Appearing from nowhere, It'll fill with light And squander it… So the year continues…

343-9

The calculation is on you — A chance was given. Not just a need Accepts you — You enter a trance.

342-8

The satisfied bird watches from around the corner, How I must look around for it In comprehended, spoken, heard words. Call and hide But don't miss the moment In my declining age To surrender to my student — Wait for me At the finish line.

341-7

The chain of transformations will be called vanity, The storehouses of treasures — food for corrosion. For future generations we gather with you, For humanity's experience, for more perfect norms.

Finally into a glass, and from it to the throat, From the gut through kidneys to pores… The overflows of essence only change form, So that again into the tank The motor pumps.

339-9

The face of life is in the mirror of death, In longevity you understand the finale better. In memory the Images are not quite erased, Something you'll manage to preserve. At the beginning you appear to realize the end, At the finish to recall the start. To inform darkness about light — That's what for. To learn to distinguish good from evil, Not to sadden, but to gladden.

338-9

The enemy won't attack, The thief won't dig under, Trouble won't come, When there is care.

337-9

336-9

So the boat floats, And the touch of an idea Leads into the eternal, into the holy and pure.

328-8

In faith is life!

309-2

We'll stop tolerating rudeness And walking paths of untruth — Beggars will turn into gentry, In anger we'll learn to love.

307-2

305-9

303-9

The feeling of lack Pulls to steal. Hot appetites — Even to attack. Fear yourself And your desires — May the cup pass Of bitter repentance. Let them rather steal from you, But explain to them too About heaven's expectation And peaceful dreams.

Little do others carry Around, But for me enough Is the Key Word.

In mosaics of diverse colors To solve the most important rebus.

299-8

298-8

Come out of battle victorious, Cherish your own, reliable and fresh. Hold the hilt and be yourself.

297-9

296-8

In overcoming time and space You and I were — In awaiting completion And in nostalgia for the past.

295-8

Looked doesn't mean saw, Listened doesn't always mean heard. You say you did, but actually botched, You think you lived — consider you were. 294-8

293-8

A straw hat and a traveler's staff — A schemer-thinker, a bum and a beggar. They drive away the romantic dreamer, He's trash for society, for he lives differently. 292-8

Billions of angels watch The fight in the Donetsk ring. They're not interested when in the first minute And in the first round Goliath knocks down David. This isn't a show. 291-9

Not just a source. Having entered the blood, The planet's soul itself Will cleanse slags, strengthen And resurrect. Having left withered bouquets, It'll hurry to the sea with the ocean. Whether with a happy aftertaste That on Earth the Life project Was impossible without us?

290-9

289-9

The taut string screams-silences, The string of the soul.

Resettled. By someone, to a new place. Where to appear? Don't know, not sure. What to pack? A change of clothes, food supplies? One thing is known: To stop the invasion not with word but with deed, — I'm missing — A body is needed.

287-9

For the turtle to burrow into silt, For the eagle to rise above clouds, To fear sharks in seas, Flocks graze peacefully. Until he becomes God, He won't calm down.

286-8

I am not — in countries, cities and villages, Among those who are beaten, who beats, In societies of the sad and merry Except those where I am. I am in thoughts about myself, about kin, About food, water and air, About the micron and the Universe, about God and disbelief, About the living and the dead, about the rich and poor. With thoughts I am — in countries, cities and villages, Among those who are beaten, who beats, In societies of the sad and merry Is my agitation. All is filled with me And drawn to me. Who will say I'm not? The Universe is me. I AM!

285-9

Fatigue from happiness and fatigue from grief — A gear change in evolution's transmission. The grandeur of the atom and the narrowness of the sea Lead to maidans and revolutions. Claims to the world And dissatisfaction with oneself Break the closed Obstacle of stagnation. Nothing to be done, such is the plan. Sometimes with the people, sometimes alone Sometimes you must overcome extremes, Strive for some, flee from others.

284-9

283-8

282-8

281-9
