And suddenly realizing That you managed to survive, How it happened, You'll admit stunned The inability to comprehend.

280-9

Jealousy in dreams And trust awake — What other proof of love is needed? Flirt and jokes in words Add new strength of love On the go without batteries, Without oaths and promises of virtues. You simply breathe happiness, Considering it natural, In the mornings you write down verses About the Lord's blessing. Fate is not your jumping through bushes, Not the success of a wise thinker, Not your parents' efforts, It is from the Patron.

279-8

Delivered the letters — Be blissful. They read them. Over them they cry, kiss and embrace them. Not you wrote And not yours they accept. Yours is to distribute, Not to confuse and to remember, To bypass all addressees. In intimacies of feelings you're a mediator, In envelopes a confession, Love's flame, someone's sorrow… You are a pipe for water, A wire for current. And don't grieve that your name is nowhere Neither in the stamp nor in any corner. No one among people will recall it. But till times it will hide The reliable archive of eternity.

278-9

Curiosity leads to the light In which, like a bubble, it cracks. Confess, why do you so beckon, education? Who decides about meeting you? Darkness pushes from below. Isn't it the cause? Yesterday a human proclaims himself God, And today a machine. So much for evolution, Homo sapiens is not the pinnacle. So a resolution is called for: The Red Clay has served its time.

277-9

The charms of attraction, Attributes of love — Negligees and accessories For fastening and removing. To the peak of achievements The last obstacle. For donning and doffing Is their nature. Bearers of mystery, An offer of oneself, Erotics in industry — For the buyer to ignite, For the seller to enrich.

276-8

It seems a samurai too Suits poetry. Claims to yourself Compose already paired with him. In the shortest form, In a few lines, In life's storm In the stingiest words. Better to forget about harakiri, Whatever the tribunal judges. Wouldn't it be better to hear from fate About a victorious finale?

275-7

A surname has a reason But not everyone knows about it. Yet on every person The family brand influences. Registered as Malomuzh Feels small, But why Is he proud as a king? The power of the word In scolding and praise — The forefathers' foundation Lives in you too.

274-9

A glance underfoot, but thoughts above. A busy world, And in it a bubble. Such are my thoughts about Diana, Everyone has sacks, but she has a handbag. Curiosity and inquisitiveness, A full bosom of dreams, And with them even The surname Rii as well. A swarm of desires and aspirations, Hopes and expectations. So I wish achievements, Diana Rii.

273-9

Velvet shadows of firs, Mountains painted by nature, The trusting clatter of storks, Beyond expanses again expanses. Masterpieces on the shop windows of beauties Beg to be on canvases. Suddenly from the side a stream murmured And a carefree soul sang. The charm of the Carpathians beckons so, Removes all sinfulness from you… If love to the edge hurts so, Then how will the sky hurt?

272-9

Surrounded with manure Will yield well. The humiliated will be glorified. Who harms today, Will break tomorrow. The cunning will outwit himself, Will swim to the simple. From the miser will fly away, The deprived will find. How not to believe in karma? In the cycle of things? Well conceived Regarding all ideas.

271-9

The viper flees When God commanded, Or bites. Silently, without words. Conscience is appointed To explain to evil About immediate readiness To stop sinning. Listen to it, Don't wait for the viper. You'll avoid the snake, Torments will be forgotten.

270-9

Two truths on the battlefield Talk about Truth. You and I Aren't even asked. One takes away, The other doesn't let go, And you and I Are devoured by death. It turned out too little To visit as guests, Encroachment poured out Into beastly angers. To own another's And keep one's own Became to kill with truth And to survive with truth.

269-8

They'll manage without you. As you without them. Heaven decides About the good and evil. They pull wagons, And in them trash. For you weighty Is only your thought. You comprehend like Seneca. You compose into volumes. You survey from afar… — At least do something.

268-9

A clean sheet is ready for anything. Waited long and, if needed, will wait more. Maybe an artist will apply a stroke, A writer will stack lines, Gather into an essay, Or a child will chop for a collage. Until it's needed, Until inspiration delays, The sheet knows how to wait And often in stacks, To absorb into the soul Scratched voiceless words. To drink of paints And delight the eyes, To tear, or curl, Or allow itself to be hanged.

267-9

Thought drags languidly, The word got tangled in dreams, Nothing is aspired to, Peace resembles collapse. Well, the fullness of comfort, Wasn't it what you were going for? But challenges of another sort Offer a different catch. In parking or in neutral You won't relax for long. By inertia I'll go to work — Something will happen.

266-7

Before the neighbor in heroism The cries of principles will subside, With shame of names and faceless Disappointed guests will disperse (Tolerance is a rarity for flesh). In the heavenly archives it will be written: "Inspired to stand out in everything Egoists will leave for memory Vain attempts to dominate." The glow of stars goes blind in cities. As if burghers are hidden even from God. The grandeur of the sky, fear before the Universe Flee, ashamed, ignored.

265-8

Friends swore loyalty, But, having broken etiquettes, In mutual tension They grabbed pistols. Accessibility to many capabilities — Etiquette. Revealing identities in contradictions — Priority in relations. We'll save friends, Save cartridges, When the obstacles Of murderous illusions are removed.

264-6

There are people — firewood, Who are burned So others warm themselves. They, like heroes, Are then praised And forgotten More and more. So they try To survive, Choose to avoid Becoming a victim. By truth, But dead. Only the conscious know That above they are awaited. Death's fright Must be overcome. The question: How?

263-9

A rainbow with the sun behind, When clarity and truth are behind. Facing darkness They go to battle, Surrender to untruth — pay for betrayal. For evil I'll be condemned, Over myself I'll weep, I'll lose friends, Lose relatives. A reliable rear — Good and light. So to the luminaries I relate kindly.

262-9

An echo of youth So distant, With an off-scale sensitivity, Not erased to the end. From the very core, From the center of the gut It asks to the surface. Barely touches it And back to the core Swiftly relates. Into the very first cell Of one's essence, Into the first cause... For all will perish, But it is alive.

261-9

Not epigraphs with explanations that they read, And not a menu of what I'll eat, But spirituality the heavens send, Energy from the Creator and Truth. When I see or hear, Smell or taste, Or touch At the level of sensations — I don't exist, But consume What was sacrificed by someone. In agonies someone suffered And we suffer. Not just I breathe And not just I live, Languidly or with passion I tear from myself, What was gifted by someone I guard and value, Directed from hearts I embrace and kiss.

260-9

When needed, let's not shun maidans, To serve the people doesn't mean dictators. The time comes to get rid of shackles Under freedom's flag. When the leader wants, But God doesn't command, There's no choice To satisfy both… Knowledge is flexible, It's unseemly to err, Let's distinguish greedy human And eternal blessed Divine.

259-9

I step on Circumstances, Don't allow To crush me. I remove The wrong, Let the dead and dry Bloom. In zealous efforts Reaching peaks, Without abandoning Ancient laws. Not to lose the track And not to lose the route Help the categories Of time's cyclicity. So I find the new, Dull or sharp Only by passing for the umpteenth time The well-forgotten old.

258-9

I don't write, and they won't write to me. And then it's not worth Complaining of loneliness. From closedness they remain alone, Realize the irreversibility Of missed days. Around it boils with enemies and friends, Relations add cheerfulness, Don't let sit too long in the hermit's zone, Much benefit from them. But they bring harm — Too many non-friends, Especially among such as a reward, I try to seek comrades.

257-9

To die attacking Or defending — The choice is distinct: hell or heaven. Cain the victorious, Gaining the world, Lose yourself. Leader or hanger-on, Master or slave, Of only two harbors Discern at least Which is profitable for you Be it for a year Or for an age… To become expelled from Life A man decides…

256-9

The storm cleanses forests, And with them orchards, Fells emergency roofs, Leaving the strong standing, Forces the healthy to flee, To then return back To clean up And grow better. Horde, Locust And earthquakes, Frost, water or fire Bring trouble and temptations, Itch of soles and palms. And you, beaten Ukraine, Blackened by ruins and fires, Shattered and washed with blood, You'll be sanctified, resurrect and bloom again.

255-8

Toy, you won't outwit the player. Spinning top, you won't always spin, Match, you may not burn out, And even if you burn out, You won't shine forever. A doll can be cherished, Glued and hemmed. A doll for fate — and you. It's risky to glorify yourself — If the master wants, still unfinished He may expel. And however brave we are, It's not worth even thinking of becoming gods.

254-9

Golden buttons, Exquisite aiguillettes On the dandy's uniform demonstrate to the public Feigned talents Of supposedly a genius, If not the wisest, The most just And the kindest. But he, like everyone, Periodically wants to eat, Gets burned or wets himself — Will look stupid, And someone over him, As over a fool, will laugh.

253-9

Our grandmother is a kind landlady, What she owns, she gives away And rejoices greatly from it, Squanders property, including mine. Relatives are offended at her, For she lets us go poor into the world. But she doesn't repent, And doesn't plan to repent, Says she's trying To raise us worthy, To hope not for inheritance, But on our own strength, So we don't become lazy And don't beg from people.

252-7

Called me wise — not just praised. Declared Responsible for truth. I hold to it with all my might From the front, sides and behind. I have no right to bathe in glory — It's not mine. Poisonous stolen glory, Thief is the name of its bearer. I'm just a carrier, a participant in transmission, And God's eye watches me. The WORD is truly wisdom's owner, And glory belongs to Him.

251-9

Inspiration took a day off. Not because it got tired, But I'm sad — So it got sad too, And I slept seemingly well, The dream didn't trouble much, But something echoed in memory, The word stumbled, Not so brave anymore From the barriers of offenses. Not mine, but at me. Was not right for someone. Inspired word, Forgive me, I'm angry at myself.

250-9

Behind locked doors the household is calm, An unprotected house attracts burglars. Carelessness breeds wars And beggar-pilgrims. A reliable shield of the state, Strong gates and a bolt Curb the predator's appetite, Which flares up especially at times. Having installed armor, And armor under it, They'll withstand fire, Protect the country, and with it kin.

249-9

What's this frequent dream about? I got lost in a foreign city. With a crashed-program phone, Lonely and alarmed I'm free as in a cage. I dream the sun rises, The nightmare is forgotten. But reality leads To knots that won't untangle. So I keep sleeping, Don't want to wake up, So I'll fall asleep in the dream, The answer is postponed till morning.

248-9

Wakened at three thirty-three, By four versified. By half past four moved — Fixed by consciousness. Conscience inspired In the night's silence — The word sifted Nectar for the soul. Edited till five, Continue sleeping. From fate, taken by the reins, I await results.

247-7

I gather dust behind the wind, Leave my problems to nature. I follow the light, Theorems lead. I develop and complement, Help without hindering. Pull and push, Fan without blowing out, I have the opportunity — I'll fix it. I can't, but I know — I'll say.

246-9

Paintings fill Museums, Painted with a tear — Into the heavenly archive. Look from the battlefield Orcs grab Trophies, Ignoring orphans and widows. They don't notice the crippled, Even multiply their trouble. Angels gather tears — Inform the Judge of cruelty. The verdict is sent back As justice's boomerang. The tear returns To the aggressor — revenge with napalm.

245-7

Day is the planet's cheek Seeking light, the star's flame, Wrapped in vacuum, in nets, Whether below or above. Holding the sun's hand, Not to fall off the footbridge of orbits, Earth seeks a window in space, Doesn't stop its flight. When will it finally behold The marked goal? And the sun warms in dance: "Trust me, I'll lead."

244-9

Advice is given correct, The instruction is true, alive, Deceived souls and wounded ones Need word-medicines. The wise wife reproaches: "You confidently teach others, Is your science not false, When you yourself sin like nobody?" Right. I don't argue, I can't manage, I admit. And again I stumble on thoughts: "Medicine is the Word." I heal with the Word And distribute it to the sick.

243-9

I contradict the Creator, Cling to life. He measured out, And I resist. With cheerfulness and sleep, With surface and bottom, With doctor and lawyer, With lost and taken. With fridge, TV, Global and petty. I go to the dentist, Bear children, Bring salary, Sweat and work. Tear and grab, But I'll hear the verdict: "Enough." And I die.

242-8

Cinema is also reality, And books in their own way carry fates. Every hobby or specialty Offers a separate reality and essence. Memory is yesterday, Imagination paints tomorrow. And the present? How do I see it? Does the soul have it, or had it? Won't I lose what was received today? Fantasy and memory, past and future, Another's and one's own — many galaxies. Even if torn to pieces — Separately and together — LIFE!!!

241-9

Cinderella and the Frog Princess, Kotygoroshko and the Ugly Duckling Left third-rateness behind, In humiliations awaited their recognition. The primitive funny villager, A mockery for urban "advanced", Shocks and captivates the spirit With masks suddenly thrown off. Proving to be an intellectual With depth of wisdom, An exemplary ideal Of beauty and courage. (To blogger Dmytro Kravchenko)

240-9

The spurred world after the Big Bang Flies by stars from stars, Moving away from them. Avoiding chaos, keeps the ranks. Tearing apart, But preserving. From primitive clarity That all is in fog, To the rebus of participation Of intellect in competition… From dogs to the snail, From summit to foundations, From the Babylonian boss To the wife's assessment.

239-9

It came out careless from orbit, Broke the comfort system, I'll start seriously appreciating The dearest that I had to keep. It didn't leave till the end, Though not someone betrayed, but I, — Remained a symbol of hope, Repentance for return. Opportunity patiently waits, I correct the mistake quickly. Persistence promises Fulfillment of old dreams.

238-7

Lucky was the last one Who jumped on the tram's step. For him, the last, The first to get off. Didn't freeze long at the stop, Maybe even rode sitting, At the exit managed without queues, Without extra "excuse me". A lucky one who makes it everywhere, Avoiding traffic. Fate helps him, Teaches to understand schedules.

237-8

The body and thoughts of the lazy wither. A man depresses in stagnations without change, Not used to resting constantly, And life's laws remind of movement. An abandoned knife has rusted, And bread has gone stale — Consume it now. Expect anxiety in idleness. Movement preserves soul and body. About movement The spirit cares. It advances And pulls back. It reliably keeps a cheerful tone In building bridges and barricades.

236-7

Helping intensely, One day I'll stick out my tongue. They'll find the guilty one — Me. The exhausted horse. And I won't beg for mercy. They'll shoot, Skin, Let for meat. They'll devour And go further, Find others, Force to pull. So I pull humbly, I pull moderately, For such is fate, For one must pull, Thinking of the tongue, Not sticking out The alpha male from oneself.

235-9

A Buddhist pacifist raised A rebellion, Gathered a bloodthirsty crowd On the square, Outraged with a call to repentance Fellow citizens exhausted by dictatorship. "To the pitchforks with him! We need revenge! What peace? Away with the usurper!" "Peaceful cooperation with a tyrant is false, If not freedom, then better death." What humanity is, hard to recall, Peace is a mirage, victory a mirage. The monk asks: "Stop killing!", — Whips up in the people a courage for violence.

234-8

The waters broke, Everyone scattered, Labor began, Am I not late? In my hands Two lives. What, three! The woman in labor's groin doesn't hold, And I still have to carry To the operating room. The two of them and myself. If only not too late… It's about to burst…

233-9

We are only emigrants, Peaceful settlers. They say about us: "occupiers," — The local natives. There aren't so many of them, Empty territories. We go to settle Unplowed ruins (Actually plundered, But better to forget about it). They kill us here Opponents of civilization. That's why they drive savages Into camps-reservations.

232-7

Is this a diary: "Can't wait for Monday", "Looked at her for a long time"? In the vanities of weekdays I tear apart: Mutuality or was I wrong? "Today she was sad", "Laughed loudly". In thoughts only she, Nothing else — Was skipped. This is not a diary at all — From worthless stubs. Nothing interesting. Ordinary fuel of love.

231-6

Muse of muses Music, queen of sounds — Cacophony of nature, animals and people. Solemnity of meetings, longing of partings. Grandeur of thunder and creak of doors. It aches in the chest, Tears with adrenaline, Hums in weekdays, Roars on synths. The crush of the Universe, The language of neutrons, And without Adam's babble The Demiurge's Word.

230-9

Sound covers space, Habit covered the process with itself. The eye asks the eyelid to close, Waxed — covered, anointed. For the vector to cover distance, Walked — covered, went, Age is the covering of years. To cover — to pass, to skip, The mouth skipped — Means ate. Twisted — skipped the screw, Spent — skipped what he had, Wire is skipped like a probe. Drew with a kretka (skipped). What a kretka is — some knew, some didn't.

229-9

No foundation, but many masters. And they'll pay each for idleness. But I find that I'm guilty too, Though I'm nobody here, and the project isn't mine. Best to hide behind others' backs, Let the confused boss rack his brains. The wise are silent, look innocent, They know — in a moment the cable will snap. The planet on a hair Is hung for nothing, But somehow the guilt Is ascribed to me too.

228-6

Adam toils not so, And rests not so, His taste is bad, He steps not there. "Time to change something. So it gets better, Let him at least start chopping? What is a husband for?" "Enough of that garden for me. Uproot the trees!" He goes. No help — Eve ordered.

227-8

Why Caligula? Just liked it, And Lucifer sounds even better… What we call ourselves, we'll resemble, Having let fate go to waste. Until it surfaces by itself, Or you'll get interested In the child's Name. With despair Suddenly it will pierce, And you'll repent With belated conscience. Pleasant to the ear And the meaning is fine, But an evil spirit in it, Invoked karma.

226-9

They knew the way, Did troubles. With time forgot about it. Would recall again, But memory is securely locked. Someone took And who knows where Hid so — No one will find… Bury evil in yourself, So that not only you But others too Couldn't find it.

225-8

Awakened by idea, Conceived in thought, Expressed in sound, Drawn in letter, Sealed in an envelope. Agreement or coercion, Construction or destruction, Absorbing or shaking out — Materialization. Denial or approval, When they say: Done. Fullness and glorification — THE WORD!!!

224-8

Who, if not Gog, heir of Cain, will avenge Cain? Abel will wait for truth. The boomerang of hatred will fly back, Though Cain would look like a saint. Indulged evil? Loved evil? Gave the cup To the bloodsucker? Aren't you Cain? Haven't you too gained The status of a murderer? Justice will return Home From captivity, But it won't do Without Armageddon.

223-8

Led by someone Deprived of foundation Is a Ukrainian Without a native language. A door without a lock, A house without doors, A mouth without a tongue — Easy prey For insidious people. A yard without gates, Through bushes — without boots, Without a flashlight at night, Without a soul. For the words are foreign.

222-6

Not up for romance, Though romantics ask, Give at least wrappers, For they don't bring candies. And better yet sympathy, At least a crumb of humanity. Now we're not just trash, But biowaste of alienation. Pumped with hatred Both strangers and our own. We are lost to the universe, Alive for another minute.

221-9

In search of meaning, Or not, In pursuit of progress For existence, For attaining goods, In peace or in war — The time will come, Regardless of race, It will open to all, Even the blind: We fussed, Fought helplessly For His order, For His books' memory, We pushed as balls In His pot. We bubbled, Arrived travelers.

220-8

The intimacy of conception And the intimacy of departure. Without haste and without delay — However you influence nature. It seems I plan, Choose the moment, Think I control, But fall into the noose. Fate is experienced, In service of the IDEA Marked to catch — I won't escape it.

219-8

Among many friends Envy will appear, Surrounded by enemies Someone will sympathize. In tension The fragrance of relaxation, Lack of feelings For soullessness Will chastise. What came — I hold. What's absent — I rejoice. What goes — I let go, What pulls — I dream. I merge with life, From the seed forever. I'll give myself, Having first taken.

218-8

I'll dissolve In God, Leave the body, Find myself Able To comprehend the whole. I'll hatch from the egg For absent horizons, Without end, Without any repairs. Neither fire nor water Will kill me anymore, For I am not, For now I truly AM!

217-8

There stood a cart, Bothering no one, Until a "specialist" appeared — Started dragging it. Why? He felt like it To show initiative, Though an empty occupation, it's his business, If he's happy from it. "Only I toil," he says, — "And others idle? Unfair. I'll go lie down, Let them, the lazybones, work."

216-7

To torment a cat — Is to show love. They bother me — Means they love (With the aim to add Or, taking advantage, Destroy). Two ends of confrontation Are also in love — The pleasure of courtship Or the shedding Of precious blood. They love, sacrificing And demanding Mutual sacrifice. Gaining love, Let us be ready to die for it.

215-8

Constancy brings Healthy fruits. For the torn it's hard to focus — The treacherous stretch of emotions lets down, Asks for rest, Or there isn't enough time, For it trembles and awaits near trouble. You and circumstances. Lack of harmony. How to achieve it? Laws correct, not ignored, Respected from childhood And walled in old age Gather and teach to give. The excessively distant Tears, Crumpled into a heap Gets tangled. Well tended Responds with good — Is inspired by rewards and thanks.

214-9

If not for the new day, If not for the resurrection, There'd be fewer songs, Less hope for salvation. If Christ hadn't died To overcome death, What would we live by now? What would our cares be? We'd fear the end That reduces all to nothing, Wouldn't know the future That passes into eternity.

213-9

Many peers have already died. I live on bonuses, though on credit. Means I've done too little yet, The flight continues, My meteorite hasn't worn out yet. Like every soul, I strive to leave a trace, Burn to ashes, But shine so That mountains, cities and countries would see, And no curtains, drapes or walls Could stop my glow. Not to fall as Lucifer's star, To incinerate everything. Not as hail, not as whirlwind, But as a sunbeam To drill through the night — Touching with the tip, To resurrect at least someone.

212-9

Knowledge leads to result. Good to goods, evil to sufferings. In happiness and love it's easy to die, Having learned to accept death too With satisfaction of cherished desires. Hell in eternity, horror on earth For the sower of hatred. On God's scale Below and above The seekers of intrigues Lose confidence. The convinced righteous one In straight paths, In un-stolen treasures, Intended for God, Though seemingly his own.

211-7

I sought the word of the day outside, But it was born inside. Inexpressible feelings were explained by it, Better than yesterday, realized today. Understood deeper — Tomorrow I'll save, Looked wider — I'll pass the path faster, Break through obstacles. Into this world I am sent Not to idle, But to continue good, To show That I try Not to destroy, But to multiply God's.

210-9

Man hurries To give to the machine Not only work, But also thinking. The demands of civilization Are swift and unceasing, As they can, they shorten The chronology to the goal. We complain, For behind the machine We can't keep up. Even now It hears us And plans to trample Its own creator. We trampled, They'll trample us too. Drove God away? So no offense.

209-9

How does Abel live? He gathers for the Creator, Before death he'll kindle the sacrifice, Having pleased God, he dies. Cain rages: "Not his, but mine accept!" He seeks his brother, But he has already left the world, No more competitor, The last ember smolders. The altar is broken, The fire went out. For Abel to live in eternity, Not among us sinners.

208-9

"Ukraine has not yet died," — Girls in embroidered shirts sing. It lives sovereign. The song under the flag will end, The stage will empty, They'll take off the wreaths. They'll merge with the crowd, And won't recall the Ukrainian word. But there is no Ukraine, For the invader's language — "Native and real, more precisely the language". Changes for the worse. In Ukrainian Not a single adviser, They teach in Russian, And the people got used. They dream of independence — They die for it, But by neglecting the language — They lose it.

207-8

Eyes turn away, Refuse to see the truth. Give them only the pleasant At first glance, And the bright and dark As if not nearby. From the darkest They push off to the brightest — They realize truth more widely, Ego-eggs burst the crack. I don't wonder at birth And rejoice at death, When eternity is heard Before I meet it.

206-8

A bitten cat or an aged one One wants to give to mother nature, So I won't be surprised when Fate doesn't pass me by — The crippled and suffering Will be thrown at some occasion. I won't complain about cruel loneliness And ungrateful closest ones. I'll assess the situation from another side, To rise above the problem higher... …The planet tries To see the sun With human eyes and understand: Its star rejected it — what is this? …Born in the body returns back — To explain to Earth.

205-9

Not mine. Fenced off. And the line of morality is often invisible. Thievishly appropriated is dangerous and damaged, I'll regret later that I didn't restrain desires. But the pleasant always attracts. Sucked from one's own — serve another's. Whispered secret Is greedy, not to mention impolite — I want immediately and now. The guard-conscience warns: "Know yours, allotted to you. If no one touches yours, Remember that your neighbor's is also behind thick walls."

204-8

One must confess sins, Not suppress The reproaches of conscience. With fresh consciousness Throw out trash, Keep treasures And re-sort. Compensate losses And apologize. …But one wants to ask again: "And what should I confess?" When paradise fills, not hell, And gold and silver surround, To confess is truly easy, And often not needed.

203-9

Speak, soul, lie down in lines Rhymed, Seal yourself with thoughts Ordered. Anxiety of obscurity Change with peace, Fog of indifference Dispel with word. Falling and stumbling, They achieve science. Composing into verses, They save legs and hands.

202-9

Harmony, embedded in conscience, With a soldering iron and a mop In the wild herd instinct Is easy to change to another — From better to worse. A good idea And noble, Compassionate and peaceful Satan and demons Confidently turn Into an aggressive one. Honor and humanity Are incompatible with autocracy. Restraint and prudence Are hateful to evil… …New sufferings and new generations Await, alas, Irpin.

201-7

I am a word among I-banknotes, I-icons and I-houses, I-Images and I-things, I-architectures And I-overtures, Among I-shepherds And I-rams. The word is eternal, Farewell and welcoming, Healed and cripples, Began and ends. Ends to begin, Dies to resurrect. They flee from hatred to love, To be enraptured by its embrace, I am in the word. After it the hunter and by it caught.

200-9

Why is the slain more pleasing to God Than the slayer? And he who fled to live, Was left for dessert? The children of Cain And of his brothers Will intermingle. How exactly, we don't know. Whether someone wanted or not — In good and in evil They'll also be discerned. Guaranteed With a greater chance To please the Owner, As proposed in the commandments — To agree with Him In humility in advance.

199-8

The lonely complains, the married grumbles. Dissatisfaction will always be found, Won't pass by. What we have, we don't notice. We turn over what's gathered, Long for what's absent. To root for lack — Is to surrender to emptiness, For a better fate, Like for the wind, to chase. But treasures — Here they are, In the crowd and in solitude — just discern. What you have — value, Bow and take. Don't even search — Rejoice and have.

198-9

Everyone's experience is their own And everyone is wise in their own way. Depending on enthusiasms and events, I judge someone, or am myself judged. From what's understood I try to advise, From those who know better I take hints — Only together will we manage, Where to grow, where to remove bark. I hope I'm needed by you, As you are needed by me. While we live (seemingly), While you and I are earthly.

197-8

I don't blame the sun for rising From the wrong side, Nor the beetroot for bearing In the wrong season. I didn't give myself The right to live as inheritance And I didn't establish The order, But I chose Which cheek to turn And when to weed. I'll turn to the luminary with the right side, I'll till the field in summer, Let it rest with winter. I'll listen to a wise woman, Become so brave That I'll submit to circumstances Like to just superiors. And it will be well with me.

196-5

If people didn't repay the debt, And conservation of energy is an unshakable law, Why think the money is lost, That you only sacrifice, and someone is insatiable? Karma watches attentively How the sincere gives, Doesn't take away. Heals trouble, And covers expenses. Didn't return? You invested. Forgot? In heaven they saw and heard, God compensated.

195-9

However you avoid, However you try To forget the war, Fall asleep again to sirens Or flee to the basement, Hide — From the "brother" take Another dose of poison. Would this dream end, Would I wake in a palace, But again the drone hums — We wake in a trench. You strike, for they kill you. War has its own laws: Strong in truth, Though weak in body, But no one will break it.

194-9

Fused into one Minutes and hours Flow unceasingly. I don't notice growth, I think I remain where I was. But I meet someone, Though I don't ask, I'll hear or read: "And you achieved. Planted a tree, Raised children, Married off and wed, Healed someone with verses in a collection. Lived well."

193-9

I am not Buddha and not Christ, Don't call the orderlies. My verbal diarrhea — More from enthusiasms than from nightmares. Not depression and not euphoria Took hold of consciousness. Hope calls to the goal, So we'd not jump, but quietly rejoice. So I'd delight in you, And some of you — in me, With healthy words In peace with love.

192-6

Analysis of words develops intellect. Shows life spectacularly, Frees from the nets of ignorance, Successfully solves eternity's rebuses. Let them call me a bore, A dull analyst, A chatterbox — I cut a tunnel to Truth for myself Not with academism's broom, But with the Word's pickaxe. Never mind that my searches are ignored, Considered a worthless occupation. They hope the tower Will yet be built, Without the cornerstone, Fleeing from the Creator and from neighbor, From the Word.

191-5

Took? Time to give back. Wax, propolis and honey. And if you had to become a viper? Whatever anyone says, You may consider me one too, Use me For your needs. The hardworking fly flew, Wore out its wings. Didn't complain, A drop of honey is plenty. Gathered nectar, Biting, healed. And the snake wore out, Swallowed dust, And everyone only dreamed of its end. But even it was needed: Like the bee, it gave venom. It frightened, For it taught to fear. Take it all — for a strap.

190-8

Without leaving yesterday, And with it the present, You won't enter tomorrow. And the flesh trembles. Having stumbled somehow, You'll find yourself under the grass. The morning will remain Nocturnal, For long (or maybe for a moment) You'll shut yourself from the sun. In the grave seemingly decay. But the frightening of death And the soul's agitation Hints at Resurrection. The personal is intimate, not public, Sits invisible in the body, Will spread someday everywhere, When it flies to the stars. @@@(Interpretation) [Experimental visual interpretation with transliteration elements] *Experimental poem, with elements of transliteration of Ukrainian text in Latin letters and sign hints. And in the way of unusual combining of small and capital letters in this rebus are complemented the past, future, stumbling, life and death, nature, waves (vibro-), resurrection, compression, expansion, ubiquity. With spices of asemic writing.

189-8

Here it is, approaching, And I didn't guess what it's called, On what occasion And what to expect. Achieved? Not quite. It knocked on the door itself. I don't believe in projects — For someone it barely scratched quietly, For someone it thumped with feet. You'll open — you'll see. You'll let in — it will enter. Unobtrusively You'll show hospitality — It will lay out gifts. A calling! — that's what we'll say.

188-9

One's own shirt Is closer to the body. And whatever the country, It has its own interest. But for the thug's shiv To fly away, Above all needed Is heaven's will. So they'd fight fiercely, Oligarchs wouldn't steal, Allies wouldn't stop Helping, Even if new presidents were elected. Maybe America should reproach Europe, Pause with support. And later, having prevented catastrophe, Stand up for the victims again.

187-8

Ivan Zelot lives in me. I constantly carry him in myself. At times he speaks inspired words, When I ask or even when I don't. I love listening to him — A wise advisor. Offers to stir up thought, Weeds the nursery of ideas. Thank you, Ivan, For caring so. Especially at nights, When I sleep, and You — toil…

186-9

It will give fullness. Offer, refuse, Agree, forbid. Establish A goal, Whiten, blacken. The monotony of weekdays will lift And lower, Inspire, Lead To a feat, Drive away laziness, Force to activity, Turn a boat into a ship. It will take away newspaper and smartphone. Tear away from the TV… If not for the tree of temptations, Who would we be, Eve?

185-9

Downtown, an old building, Creaky floor, benches without backs. On a wobbly table antique vases. Paper trash, like in a bookstore. With ties or bow ties in elegant suits, Well sewn, They await moneyed clients In piquant conflicts... Active youth, a stadium outside the city, Friends in the park Ready for pizza. In a footballer's uniform Went to intercept My son-in-law Yura. He's a lawyer… And in the center — The Bar Association.

184-9

They stood on the veranda To watch The world's collapse, As on command They'll start destroying Us and you. An interesting show — Long awaited, Though it was postponed, But finally again They got a war. "Is it really the last?" — Asks the adrenaline. This question Of many generations.

183-9

The chemical cause of illness In the laboratory They'll find. They'll give pills, mixtures, Or bring back to life As an outpatient. Medicines replenish the lack in the body — I take them and keep sinning. Why do I hurry to burn? Or maybe go to the goal differently? Overloaded shelves Of pharmaceutical poison Will be replaced by corrected habits, To forget the hospital.

182-3

A secret facility. Found myself suddenly on its territory. Cameras recorded — Expect an unpleasant story. Stepped back through the turnstile, Late, though not caught. Seized by myself, Afraid of my own shadow. No peace — They'll come for me. If not tomorrow, then today. Conscience alarmed, Seeks a way out, When uninvited It steps on another's.

181-8

We are not slaves, and we are Jews Thanks to Sarah. She is Isaac's mother. But Hagar too, Our mother We won't let be trampled. Pagans, Christians, The lost tribes of Abraham Scattered in the world as tribes, Hindus and savages And we — Jews with you. The father of nations, the Good God, A comer from beyond the river, As promised, multiplied children. You can't deny the news — Everyone is called a Jew.

180-2

"I love only you." — My ears heard. But now I know What your sad eyes Mean, Why they seek someone, Not noticing me. Now, alas, I know Why they avoid In the world of illusions Intrusive friends Who inspire trust. Why by sharing the most cherished I sadden the dearest, Become lonelied — I powder her happiness and mine.

179-9

In competitions two poles: The best And the worst. In drawings or in verses — The lost Or a manifestation of beauty. In the middle — the attempt of the active From the primitive To break away. It's wrong for the weak To be offended at the strong. One should look up to him. Among stench and fragrances I grow then, When I catch up, And not from envy Destroy and tear.

178-9

(My brother's poem. For relaxation) What beast is there at the forest's edge Rumbling and going? It's a machine from Kutaisi, Called "Kolkhida". It tears from under itself and rumbles, Look — it blows smoke. Only it doesn't want to go, But it's good that it hums. Got lucky — it sped up, Rushes downhill — 70. It ran wild on the road, Impossible to level. Driver left — it right, Then straight and vice versa. For a second fixed somewhere, Again the wheel in fists. It rattles, puffs and just jumps, The poor driver almost cries. The spare tire hangs by snot, And the side will soon fall off. What a machine… What a wonder! Head like a camel's, A dragon tail crawls, And it carries something on itself. And the machine is like a machine. And the tank is full of gas. And the spark, like a pea, But it won't start at all. Sulima, Herus and Kavchak Learned the "Kolkhida". Each is now a master in it, They'll ride the whole world on it.

177-9

A prolonged age — the humbling of egoism, A summary of what's lived, returned karma, Of the commandment The fifth Fulfillment, Realization That all is not in vain. A slowed pension, kneading with grandchildren. And my childhood — ink and pencil case. Heard and seen with bliss and hardships, Woven into fate, knits the finale. They'd have managed here without me, But since there was demand, they hired me — Payment for the mission won't delay: Reward or punishment will not pass by.

176-9

Many people congratulated on the birthday. More precisely, Viber. Someone personally, someone from families. For in the app the timer works. Thank you to Viber and thank you to friends, Judges of my aging, Who remember. May they keep the count of years henceforth For joy or for sorrow. It's pleasant for everyone To feel In the world of loneliness and in the anxious world That there are many of us.

175-9

My home is where I found peace. Not as a guest, not in prison and not hired. Where I got rid of slavery's fetters And the poorest caste of the outcasts. Where I finally met truth And understood: My home is where I found peace. As a guest, in prison and hired, In slavery's fetters, In the richest poorest caste of outcasts.

174-9

Today is a holiday — On this day was born a man and father, Who is also considered a grandfather. Me. How to congratulate, They try to find out. What to give — The family wonders. Though long known to all, friends and strangers: annually he asks, And that's enough for him, They'd toss three times, catch three times And understand: Not for the birthday boy's glory, but so they'd remember That they had a father, Held him, Played as Dad. Took blessings from him. Shook out.

173-9

Perfect love, Described in novels, At times tested, Knew no betrayals (Or hid them well). Accepted hardships As a blessing, Drank freedom And pleasure, Tempered patience. Passed temptations, Overcame obstacles Perfect love, …For it loved life.

172-9

The observant perceives signs. He presents them outward too. Reads birth dates, And waits for the moment To declare his own. The world is molded from signs, In weather and in surnames, in thoughts and in words. Unbelted and buttoned, Combed and disheveled — In signs both joy, in signs both fear. I guess and suspect, Having turned this way Or glanced that way — Again and again I repeat to myself: My true name is Sign.

171-8

What does rhyme do In search of truth? In search of truth It is the cause. It will climb up, Dive to the bottom, Go beyond horizons, Tear the thorn, But pave the way. It will sweep away false stanzas, Choose only one. It will answer For what I find.

170-9

Bless instead of cursing. You won't just see the miracle — you'll enter it. Such gifts you'll have to accept — The expansion of barns will know no bounds. The thief will bring you trophies, Not things, but his soul he'll give you. Instead of dying — he'll live, Learn to overcome misfortune with good. The house will remain poor, For wealth will be invested in hearts. And in the heavenly books it will be written: "He was faithful to the end."

169-5

The downcast together with the saddened Rose against the world's sorrow To remind those deceived by Satan Of the essence of God's Testament. They're called sectarians, Confused with frauds, But like atlases They war with sins. Sufferers, the deprived, Thrown into garbage pits, Mocked but unbroken Wrapped in sackcloth, In camel clothes, To repent, to convert, They call the caring To meet the Messiah.

168-9

Silently, tensely I comprehend. My vocal cords rest. I cleanse my conscience, Try to avoid the trap. The Word came, the body revived, Stirred. I spoke. Not only did I want to share with neighbors — In my own speech I enriched myself. I don't waste energy on idle talk. I order myself: "Weigh everything well!" So as not to ask: "Did I really want The guard of my lips To remain asleep?"

167-9

Afraid? Blessed, Where would you go without fear? The polite one is saved, Submissive to the law of fetters. You can't go there, And don't take that, And here it will be anxious, And there expect trouble. In the center of the carousel Trembles a frightened ascetic. But paradox. Feeling his priority, His thoughts are cheerful — He's a philosopher now. A poet.

166-9

Concrete laughter, Torn fates, Masked sin, Beggarly will. A saved life, Conscience from escape, Repentance for another's guilt, Lowered shoulders. A hand on the holster Of both attacker and victim. Sad premonitions — Readiness to die. (We continue to believe that we'll soon get out of this reality)

165-1

I catch you, You catch me. You frighten the fearless. You call yesterday's future ones, And tomorrow's yesterday ones In the sacred place Called Nowhere. We are a whole herd — You won't see anyone. The road is wide — Fields and forests. On the spot a runner With legless legs. A blind sharp-eyed one — A monster of beauty. Without edge or bounds The timid brave one. A chain closed in a circle. From linear networks Into a heap beaten the lengthy, The ungraspable seized Without explanation — SPIRIT.

164-2

She chastises herself for unwisdom. Pondered the failure, Seeks a way out. Reads the newspaper, Not seeing the letters. By the window, From behind broken glass She looks for support. Jumps up, stands on tiptoe. No one will comfort, Won't toss a coin. Her own barricades The SOUL clears. While there are no others — Alone!

163-7

First they went wild, Then became dogs. They call black white, Consider everyone enemies. They beat neighbors mercilessly, Wonder greatly: Why don't they love them And don't befriend them? More than once they were believed, In trouble they were helped. But the orcs wanted too much For "greatness" To be recognized in them.

162-4

A "shirt" in blood and torn, An unfinished bottle in hands, To die or live — "it's all the same", A "chest" in orders, A head in the bushes. And how do you fight such a one, Seeing a human in him? You'll feel yourself at the slaughterhouse — As if you're grinding meat, Shooting and cutting cattle. One has to temporarily Turn beast oneself. Voluntarily or by force Overcoming fatigue, Lock the bolts Of the border, To return home.

161-5

The clever one knows, The wise one applies. It begins with knowledge, And ends with knowledge. The spermatozoon knows How to fertilize, The asteroid knows How to burn to ashes. The beginning knows How to become the finish. The living dies For it knows How to resurrect.

160-6

You'll lift yourself, And drop yourself. You'll meet what's needed, Give in — you'll stop. You'll look out — you'll see, You'll listen — you'll hear. You'll love — you'll forgive, You'll knock — you'll stay the night. You'll stumble — you'll fall, You'll want — you'll ask, You'll push off — you'll jump. Choose what you want.

159-7

I am jealous and envious, Only God is jealous — For the conversion of man. Our repentance troubles Him. But to envy Himself He has no reason. For He is the world's Master, We are His property. Can the master Fall into envy Of Himself? Or steal From Himself? Or put Not where He needs?

158-8

In every nation There are people, and there are rabble. In any adventure Both are near. The scoundrel won't upset me, I'll shake the good man's hand, I'll hold back the cup of poison And among the evil allow myself To be pleased by kind words. Then I'll be counted too As a human, not a dog, They'll appreciate and advertise As an ambassador of peace, A wonderful representative Of Ukraine.

157-8

I call Him Allah, God and Jehovah. With love and fear I serve Him. Though the names are different And countless, We choose the dear ones — And in this is weakness: Who is the true one, We argue In competitions of hearts. Until we guess: Why, He is — Our Creator.

156-2

At times I recognize the enemy Among strangers. But it costs dearly When you met him On a level road Among countrymen. Greater than kin, There are no enemies. Than close family, Than near neighbors, Than one's own in Tandem*… Who lies nearby, Sits Or rides. ____________ *Tandem — an e-app for communicating by correspondence and in group conversations.

155-7

No one heals like The Doctor above doctors. And no one will arrange Like the Rich Man above the rich. And there is no better teacher Than the Teacher above teachers. He is everywhere, Inside and among us. We breathe and live by Him, If only we'd keep company with Him, If only we'd bow to Him — But not all will recognize Him.

154-9

A birthday — A renewed countdown: Of cold, heat, fruits. An echo of past experience, Wishes in a few words. Longing for the lost year, In the mirror approaching old age. Behind a slightly slowed step The next joy is felt… In a fresh toy, at school, in love, In education, car, career, In waiting for children and grandchildren, In the cemetery, finally, enclosure.

153-9

I won't answer right away, I'll wait, Let the offense pass And suffer no losses. In a race — a mistake: Excess tension, A broken arrow, Loss of a friend. I won't rush myself, I'll slow him down, So that reliable words Reach their own.

152-9

Under the ice of sleep The neophylite* Doesn't even plan to wake. I sleep, And he, like a bandit, Calls And immediately hides. Truth tickles The subconscious, Miss it — It'll flash by. Want To catch the unthinkable? Hold up the phone — Something will fall into it. The fisherman Won't let go of the float, Attention — Is the hunter's essence. The night cheat-sheet Will polish and clean. And you'll proclaim fervently — It came in a dream! ____________ *Neophylite (a word not used before) – capable of filling anew.

151-9

Matches are useful To burn one by one, Not the whole box at once. To stroke conscientiously, Not against the fur, An angry little dog. The desperate Tend to rush, But to be late Is also not allowed. The laws of the universe are unbreakable. Each match decides How to serve in fullness, When to agree to flare up. And I have my own measure — To incinerate or extinguish. If only the goal is reached — To stop evil in the bud.

150-7

Wolf and goat — Aggressor and victim, A hopeless tear, The sated and the dead. Goat and cabbage — Vegetarianism. The safety of humanity Without wars and rudeness. Cabbage and wolf — Mutual indifference. The rapist fell silent. Doesn't growl and doesn't strangle.

149-9

And one in the field is a warrior, If in him is the spirit of Samson. He will find the needed weapon For attack And for defense. But the greatest power has The tongue's two-edged sword — The word breaks walls When you speak the truth. Before it liar and thief Lower their hands. 5 persons or 6 nations Cast aside arrows and bows.

148-6

Ivan and Marusya have A daughter and a son. Hence the nicknames — Marusyn And Ivanova Yasmin. In times when surnames were needed They used nicknames, So they'd be easily recognized. As they said, so they wrote down. Ivanova's sister, Like Marusyn — the brother. So that each family Would be considered Russians.

147-9

The anxiety of the day And of previous days Stirred up thoughts. Takes away sleep, Deprives of dreams, For it didn't listen To wise words and advice. The soul seeks peace, Tosses in bed, Peeks into the fridge, Whether it will learn How to buy off misfortunes. An answer is needed, A correction to behavior. It will lie down, walk around, sit out, Realize the mistake, To return to rest.

146-6

To savor-drink — To value processes, Not to rush to the finish, Not to push — to carry. To choose a goal Unattainable. To assemble in parts Deliberately. And leave to descendants, So they'd continue. So they'd live too. So they'd multiply, So as not to finish.

145-7

Found twice Asks to be native, Attracts attention. It will serve And won't wear out soon, Will feed and quench thirst. If only not to ignore, Not to miss, To honor, To adopt. There isn't so much of the native, Contenders for the most native. We'll accept the twice-found — Let there be more.

144-5

Valentine's Day From a man's point of view (-: My other half, The fullness of life's meaning, You direct swiftly to the goal, And without you the goal is not the same. You are the axe to the handle, The teeth to the key. Ink for writing, A soul for a lonely body. Capability for the weakened, Fuel for the engine. You drive away loneliness, That's why you're so dear.

143-6

"Ukraine is Russia", For it's written in Russian. Russia is not Ukraine, Maybe let's leave it so. Maybe enough of fraternizing? From the Stockholm syndrome Isn't it time to return — From slavery home? Do slaves dream Of becoming slave owners Over contemporary countrymen? Probably so, For foreigners Beat them, But Ukrainians, Having acquired a taste, Having filled to the brim, Drink their own blood.

142-9

Fine poems for someone — For someone a pun. You can't please everyone. Had to think, It passed like a drill In anxious awakening. Not a lesson for listeners, But a lesson for oneself, So that one's own soul, Having heard from the spirit, Understood itself And conveyed to the body. So as not to tease another's, But to govern one's own.

141-9

Stars are falling — Hold out your hat. If you fall yourself — They'll catch you. Fireflies from above Seem to put a period To times without beginning — Immortality calls. Eternity writes — Read, Attend carefully To its lessons. Spacious or tight — Gather, So that attainable Peace would prove. To the earth A star hurried, Dissolved and went out — You won't find it. But in the dark dome It punched a hole. In due time Through it You'll fall onto the sky.

140-9

Got stuff. I have. Fate gifted. But I expect more, It's not enough for me. It goes. I take. That's how it's gained. I open the drawer, And it's packed... They offer advice: What I have Is meant to help. But may also hinder, For I desire excessively.

139-5

To spit deliciously In the face of the legal State oversight. With a cigarette over the pit To proclaim: Glory to Ukraine! To slide to the bottom From a finger on the trigger Of the instrument of death. To end up in the lists Of archives of atrocities, As a henchman led against oneself. To enter weakened hearts With gratitude for freedom. …By the force of resistance.

138-9

You flee or catch up, You find or lost, Chained or flying, You meet or didn't meet. Happy or unhappy, Afraid or a hero, Free or subjugated, Ooh-ga-ga-ga or oh-no-no. In church or at work, In a foreign city or in your village, Dissolute or in chastity — In a dream…

137-9

A time to sew and a time to rip, To focus and to idle. To work And to go to sleep. To flee from threats, Or on the contrary To stand before them. Conditions will come to circumstances, If you discern. You'll grind a lot of chaff Before you unite all intentions. God will give a day, God will give food And suggest the needed plan. And yours will turn out fresh, And won't cut short The ideological bedlam.

136-9

There is someone to look up to, But despite everything One must remain oneself, Carry one's own — not another's. My love for my brother-in-arms Cheers him always — As I bear grief with him, I'll take on the harder each time. Though another's doesn't hurt like one's own, And another's joy is not mine, May my light not go out Till the finish, till oblivion. All around is beautiful In the service in which I am too.

135-8

Not always does it turn out as one wants. Would wish for peace, but there is none. Sometimes one simply has to wait, Month after month — and winter will retreat. Though beaten by stones of suffering, Truly deep joy will embrace, A tear will drop from the eye, Sweeten the wormwood of hopes. Therefore, having gathered strength, Winged by faith in truth, Not weakened in patience, not bowed We will win! No hesitation.

134-6

There is no plan B. More precisely, it will arise by itself When the time comes. Reserves will always be found When you notice them, Don't squander at once, Let them grow. Don't worry, Sleep peacefully. This and That all the way to I will wait. To reach the goal, Manage To carry what's available. And plans? They Will find you themselves.

133-9

The opponent cut off the conversation: — You have horns, hooves and a tail. They took away my chance to explain — Anger tears me apart, Though horns, hooves or tail I never noticed on myself, The matter is now not simple — They won't befriend me anymore. They "figured me out", Exposed the "satan", Spread rumors, Believed the liar.

132-9

Someone got lucky — Paints the leader. Hopes — They'll pour gold. But meanwhile life May strike with a hammer. To crawl in order to show off — An ungrateful craft. Expect losses, They'll swallow — tasty. Write for yourself, Shine for yourself. When the need comes — They'll come for the fruits.

131-9

We each go our own way With parallels and crossings, Carefree and with anxiety, With deceivers and with the honest. With bridges and tunnels, Over abysses and wading through. Sad and cheerful. We lead or follow. The road will someday end, Only not in a dead end, But to find oneself in the Creator's glory, Having bid farewell to evil forever.

130-9

They avoid criticism, Hungry for fame, Accept challenges, To hear: "Bravo!" Chase after fame — It runs away, Hide from it — It catches up. The point is not in fame, They honor the idea. They follow it, And carry the fame.

129-9

Quantity or quality? Gave birth to many children, Gathered a lot of money, Wrote many articles. Quantity. Quality or quantity? Taught the children, Paid for good, Enriched society. Quality. Did not crawl, but flew, Did not smolder, But shone, Did not watch, but ate, Did not tremble, But lived.

128-9

Is the murderer's murderer a murderer? If only I with a word Could restrain the cutthroat, When my brother was under threat. I would have convinced, and no one would have fallen. Tried again and again. With neighbors together, the whole village. What to do, I complained to God, No obstacle was found for the trouble. Evil will stop where It is stopped, Where to kill and steal They won't let it. It didn't yield to words, Hands must be twisted, Put in prison. If it continues to kill — The rabid will be killed too.

127-9

The Code of the Builder of Communism Did not work, The 10 commandments Were ignored. The firm hand of Stalinism The people demanded again. Other ideas ran out, All they could, they neglected. Aggressor and victim Steal from their own, Complain about corruption. Conscience is dead, They call for dictatorship, Though they know a more perfect way out. Do not covet your neighbor's, Do not think of adultery, Do not bear false witness, Do not steal, do not kill, Honor your parents, Keep the Sabbath. Avoid idols, Do not take God's name in vain. Believe in Him and honor Him.

126-9

Though the funeral procession Keeps moving, To think about death — Is not depression, When you perceive death As doors to home, When from heaven you await The archangels' chime. The earthly is temporary, Goes quickly and slippery. So let's remember again: Resurrection is near.

125-9

They advise not to rush, Who endures is saved. Should one always endure? How we sleep and how we walk? To run enduring And to endure sitting. To endure pulling, To let go — enduring. Patience is in persecution And in the bliss of the goal. Endure in impatience And in patience endure.

124-9

Didn't understand. Again. God called to absurd things. How to believe His Word, Not to be shamed among people? I don't want my wife to turn away again, For the brothers in church to dissect me again, Re-educate in long conversations, Convert to long-known truths, How to live, where to go. Didn't understand. I'll have to again Walk long around the mountain. If I don't trust God's Word — I'll be late myself, and with me they will too.

123-8

One fell, broke his spine, One died of cancer, One in the zone was killed by brass knuckles, She did not wake up in the morning… So we judge others, As if they lived to die. From the bad to the worst, We attribute everything to death… …Raised five children, Wrote four books, Protected seven people, Gave haircuts like no one else…

122-9

Built a fine house, Healed the sick, Gave a million to the Armed Forces, Fed the homeless. Pilot, doctor, pianist, Locksmith, nanny, journalist, Had a gift for drawing, Was a true optimist. Death took them… Let it take, Let the body rest… But their cause lives — Bringing closer to paradise.

121-9

Why apologize? We didn't meet — They regret, But they don't blame. So plans went somewhere, Spent on other things. Let's keep hoping. God willing, we'll meet again. Maybe in better conditions. We'll have a fruitful conversation At future gatherings. At times even to miss Is no sin, So that no one could torment You right away.

120-8

Thunderstorms — The condition for rainbows. Tears Bring an armful of happiness. How to look back And notice the positive? Not to err in conclusions, But to gather blessings? I'll always find the sad, It's not even sought. But whether I'll accept the good — They'll ask at the Judgment.

119-7

More and more often They hide from me. The older me Interests them less. It's not worth fleeing this truth, But accepting it with gratitude, Loneliness is useful — at the finish suddenly It becomes not sorrow, but joy. If with focus to weigh On suitcases, in hat and shod, Before the road tensely recalling, Lest something be forgotten…

118-6

Through the porthole He surveys his own — The dictator- Expropriator. His ego Is raised Above the heavens. From whom else to take, How to become more famous? He needs a lot, As if he won't die, As if risen forever. His greatest interest – That his business not vanish, To prove his greatness, To grab God by the beard.

117-9

I rejoice in a thought different From mine. But sincere and honest. Without error and cunning, Expressive and brief, Without complex constructions, Without arrogance and conceit, Impositions and swagger, So that in wondrous form, Earthly and heavenly Truth would grow — Could strengthen. So that both would agree, Drink their fill of communion, And to both would open The essence of the word. For that one needs Only to love One's neighbor and the truth. I'll climb upward, To reach the sky, To let sin be forgiven. To live more fully… …To teach the soul… So let's keep talking.

116-8

The West builds, The East destroys. For example, Kyiv founds Moscow. It surrounds the Kremlin with walls, And then begs it for mercy, Brings upon itself Trouble by its own hands. The predator lurks in ambush, The victim grew rich — time has come. Glad for toilets and fridges — Moscow will drink its fill of blood. You multiply estates, You bear children. You think you do good, But in the end you find That you yourself bring — To yourself and others Suffering and evil.

115-3

Laid into nature Is more energy Than into photographs. You see the soul's structure. You hear elegies From within a person. A photograph — Is a cross-section, A torn-out moment, Though beautiful, Hides the boundless. It lies breathless. But greater in the living Is the threat to the artist. It causes nausea — The splinter of attachment.

114-7

You gather treasures for yourself — They'll find out and come for them. You satisfy someone's needs — The grateful will carry you in their arms. Fate itself determines Where you retreat or hurry forward, You save when there's enough. They ask — then you give. But if the market is overfull And no one needs anything, Then rest has come. You can stay home a while.

113-3

You can't lie in bed long, The body needs movement. A thought, by idea, by word Suddenly awakens the spirit. It would seem all works, Nothing leaks anywhere. The soul paints new ideals, For it wants more. It will feed the body first, And then take up the spirit. The soul cannot be idle, Its element is eternal movement.

112-8

Sound is primary* 聲音是主要的， Shēngyīn shì zhǔyào de, Шенґйін шІі жУуУйАао да, Writing is secondary. 二次寫作。 Èr cì xiězuò. Еер шІі ксіЕеЕжуОо.
